notes.title: Dedicated Server Update Now Live
notes.content:
[p][b]Dedicated Server Release Now Live[/b][/p][p]
Realmwalkers, our new Dedicated Servers are now live. To get started, download this update and create a new character or download one of your online characters to play. You can choose to play solo, join, or host a Friend.[/p][p]
Your online characters will continue to be hosted by Inflexion and will be available to download for up to a year. For more information about this update, please check out our last blog post [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1928980/view/557999619725853069"]here[/url].[/p][p]
[u][b]Release Highlights[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p][b]Dedicated Servers[/b] - Use our new Dedicated Servers to host or join a friend! We have also partnered with GPortal for paid hosting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Start Menu[/b] - The start menu has been re-organized to make it easier to create a new character and then choose how you want to play[/p][/*][*][p][b]Online Character Download[/b] - You can now download your online characters to be used offline directly from the Start Menu. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Admin Panel[/b] - You can enable some of the debug tools and cheats our team finds helpful if you want to experiment with Nightingale. You can find more information about how to do this on our FAQs page here: [url="https://playnightingale.com/faqs"]https://playnightingale.com/faqs[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Monikers![/b] - You can now earn titles for your Realmwalkers that are displayed under your username.  Find the Moniker that represents who you are in Nightingale—from the classic [i]Realmwalker[/i] and the accomplished [i]Network Weaver [/i]to the whimsical[i] Chuckaboo [/i]and the chaotic[i] Rapscallion.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Nightingale Dedicated Servers – Powered by GPORTAL[/b][/p][p]Our upcoming Dedicated Server release gives you the flexibility to play Nightingale how you want, whether you prefer to host your own Realm or play with friends.[/p][p]To make this possible, we’ve partnered with [b]GPORTAL[/b] to provide  easy-to-use servers around the globe. With GPORTAL, setting up and managing your own server is quick and seamless so you can focus on exploring, building, and surviving in the Fae wilds.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Additional Bug Fixes and Updates[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Item Rewards: Players now automatically receive the Cleansing Card when its requirements are met[/p][/*][*][p]Fishing & Store: Fishing mini-games have been adjusted and issues in the Porter Pistol shop purchase have been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Effects: The Ultimate Sickle weapon’s bleed damage has been reworked for clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Updated outfits and appearances of several NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Building swapping - In placement mode, added the ability to swap targeted structures with the new structure, with resources being refunded and/or dropped to ground. Tileset pieces and hanging lights/decorations can be swapped out with tileset pieces of the same type (eg. doorframe and a doorframe, but not a doorframe and a wall). Freestanding structures can be swapped if their size matches.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved issues when swapping weapons[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]UI & UX[/b][/p][list][*][p]Connect Screen: The Continue button on the host/connect screen now only activates when an address is entered[/p][/*][*][p]A Previous/Next host button has been added for easier navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]Moniker Support: A new Moniker tab in the player Inventory lets you set custom name titles, and those monikers now show on player nameplates[/p][/*][*][p]Profile Picker: You can now create more then 4 characters in profile creation[/p][/*][*][p]Travel UI: Clicking the opposite arrows on the travel map will now cycle travel direction, and the travel HUD groups “Accept”/“Decline” actions together for clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Ultimate charms now use tier coloration[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for BodyTypes in character creation
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Social Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Parties: Parties are now based on who is on a server.[/p][/*][*][p]Players now see on-screen notifications when someone joins or leaves their party[/p][/*][*][p]Party Voting: A new Party Voting system lets group members vote on quick travel destinations.[/p][/*][*][p]Friend Join: Steam friends can now join your game when you host (via Steam relay)[/p][/*][*][p]Travel Invites: New safeguards automatically deny a travel invite if the host is still on the Continue Journey screen[/p][/*][*][p]Removed non-functional respite permissions 
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Performance and Stability[/b][/p][list][*][p]Addressed a GPU crash that was occurring on some systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized creature spawning[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]New spatial audio for Provisioners Borough, the Docks, the Portal Transcept Spire in The Watch[/p][/*][*][p]New audio for The Watch Pale Suppression Quest
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Quests & Rewards: Corrected a quest description (“A Gate to the Void”) and fixed a bug where a reward room’s teacup item was missing[/p][/*][*][p]Environment: Resolved several minor world glitches (e.g. blocked holes in city districts). Players can no longer get stuck in a hidden room due to level geometry issues[/p][/*][*][p]Other Fixes: The portal activation button in the Vaults area now works correctly, and various UI tooltip and text issues have been cleaned up (such as leftover “XP/Masterwork” labels)[/p][/*][*][p]Audio: Fixed an echo-related audio bug in one quest area (Sunken Hope cathedral)[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for collectible busts that weren’t previously collectible[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing teacup from reward set[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed characters falling if attacked while swimming[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed zone control VFX not happening in multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed magic realm card buff to correctly apply damage bonus[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed item stacking not taking into account all characteristics[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the torches in the Crossways to no longer flicker[/p][/*][*][p]Fix bug where crafts would not finish in offline mode after restoring from persistence[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a mismatch of tiers for Dumplings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the description of Immolation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the description of Tudor Stove and Regency Stove[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Masterwork Bow Arms could be used as Poles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect recipe component for Masterwork Longbow[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where dialogue options were missing when multiple players turned in a quest at the same time[/p][/*][*][p]Family lineage will now persist[/p][/*][*][p]Memory puzzles being solved concurrently will no longer interfere with each other[/p][/*][*][p]Rescue NPCs who get stuck can now return to navigable terrain[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed portal activation not working in Boss champers and Vaults[/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p]

notes.title: PTR Recap and What’s Next for Nightingale’s Online Experience
notes.content:
[p][b]PTR Recap and What’s Next for Nightingale’s Online Experience[/b][/p][previewyoutube="fz0Cr1mJ3FU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]With the release of our Dedicated Server update on the Public Test Realm (PTR), we hoped to validate two things. First, that the core functionality worked as expected. Second, playing on a Dedicated Server offered a good - or even better - experience to our own hosted infrastructure.[/p][p]Thanks to those of you who jumped in, we were able to do both. We spotted bugs, got useful feedback, and saw players having fun with some of our new features, like the admin panel and Monikers.[/p][p][b]Reevaluating Online Play[/b][/p][p]With the success of the PTR test and after talking with players in our Discord AMA, we sat down as a studio to talk seriously about Nightingale’s online future.[/p][p]In our last Dev Diary, we mentioned that the original vision for online play never quite came together as we had imagined. Looking at the data, many players are using our hosting infrastructure to play solo, and only a small fraction are playing in larger five or six person groups. This reality has made it hard to justify continuing to maintain the online infrastructure when we could use those resources elsewhere in development.[/p][p]With that in mind, we’ve decided to migrate away from the Inflexion-hosted infrastructure and instead focus our development efforts on where players are spending their time most while ensuring you can still play Nightingale for as long as you want.[/p][p]This is different from our original vision of a connected universe of realms, but the mechanics remain the same. You can still realm dive with your friends by opening portals, or establish connections to Friends realms. Those realms will just be hosted on a distributed server infrastructure rather than a centralized one. With dedicated servers now in place, players can still host games and play with friends. It’s just happening in a different way than we initially imagined.[/p][p][b]About Online Characters[/b][/p][p]It is very important that your online characters and Realms will still be hosted by Inflexion for the foreseeable future to download. We wanted to make it easy to transition to offline play and have made them available for download in the Main Menu. [/p][p]Once downloaded, you can continue playing solo, join a friend's game, or host one yourself. We've tried to make the process straightforward and will continue to listen to your feedback as we make this transition.[/p][p][b]Introducing GPortal Hosting[/b][/p][p]To support those who want the highest quality multiplayer experience, we’ve worked with GPortal for server hosting. This is a common setup in the survival crafting genre and should make it easier for players to coordinate and play together.[/p][p]We’ll keep collecting feedback on how Dedicated Servers and GPortal are working, and use that to guide future improvements.[/p][p][b]Looking Ahead[/b][/p][p]We know this shift may not be what some players were expecting or wanting. But it's important to make changes that support the long-term health of the game and the studio.[/p][p][b]To help answer any of your questions, we’re  hosting a live Ask Me Anything session with the dev team on Tuesday, July 15 at 10:30 AM MT on our Discord. [/b][/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us. Nightingale continues to evolve, and your support helps make that possible.[/p][p]The Nightingale Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Nightingale June Update
notes.content:
[h1]Realmwalkers,[/h1][p]It’s been a few months since our Nightingale City update and we wanted to take a moment to step back and share where things stand, not just with Nightingale but with some of the broader work going on at Inflexion. More than anything, we want to share how we’re approaching the road ahead.[/p][p]A lot of our recent work has focused on long-term planning for Inflexion. That of course includes Nightingale, but also other projects we’re exploring as a studio. It’s not always the most visible kind of work, but it’s important, especially now given the realities of today’s games industry. Taking the time to plan well means we can keep developing the games we love.[/p][h3][b]Reflections on Nightingale[/b][/h3][p]Nightingale has been at the center of many of those conversations. We care deeply about this game. It’s ambitious and complex, and we’ve poured a lot into it. It hasn’t always been easy, but we believe in its potential and in the community that’s come with us this far.[/p][p]One of the biggest considerations has been our online architecture. From Nightingale’s earliest days, we aimed to create a shared-world experience that let groups of players join together to adventure in the Fae Wilds. The back-end architecture we created delivered that vision, with players connecting realms to other realms with magical portals. The team did a great job. But at the same time it meant constraints and limitations on our overall development speed and on gameplay elements that we’ve never resolved. Now with  more than a year of early access, it's clear that many players prefer to play solo or with a few close friends, further complicating what we do going forward.[/p][p]The other difficult truth is Nightingale’s review status on Steam. It’s nobody’s job but ours to make a game worthy of good reviews. But we’ve been sitting at “Mixed” for a while now, and that hurts because it reflects a gap between what we want the game to be and how it’s being received. Steam reviews matter because they shape how new players see the game and we know we have work to do if we’re going to improve them.[/p][h3][b]What We’re Doing Next[/b][/h3][p]To address the first challenge, we’re nearly ready to release our dedicated server. This has been in the works for a while, and it will allow you to host a dedicated server the way you do with many other survival games: privately, reliably, and on your own terms, while still enjoying diving realmdiving from realm to realm through portals you build or discover. We’ll have more to say about the specifics on that soon.[/p][p]As for the Steam review score and the broader player experience, that’s a bigger challenge. There’s no single feature or fix that will solve it. But we’re spending this summer focused on finding the right path forward, one grounded in what we’ve learned since Nightingale's launch.[/p][h3][b]Thank You[/b][/h3][p]If you’ve played Nightingale, left feedback, or even just kept an eye on what we’re doing, thank you. We’ll keep sharing more in the weeks ahead as we prepare for our next update, and we’ll continue doing the work to make Nightingale a game worth your time and support.[/p][p][/p][p]Take care,[/p][p]The Realmwalkers at Inflexion [/p][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="efpBPaROZGs;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Nightingale demo lets you check in on the revitalized fantasy survival game
notes.content:
It's been a long road for Nightingale, but it feels like momentum is finally in its favor. The early access survival game landed to a decidedly frosty reception in February 2024, with its beautiful world design marred by underwhelming combat, a lack of direction, and restrictive building caps. Developer Inflexion Games has made a lot of changes since then, however, with the transformative 'Realms Rebuilt' update followed by major crafting, customization, and build mode improvements. Most recently, it opened the doors to Nightingale City and another tier of endgame gear options. Now, it invites anyone who might be curious to try the game for free with a limited-time demo and offers a serious discount if you like it.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Nightingale City Update
notes.content:
Our latest update is now live and adventures in Nightingale City awaits.

[b]Defend Nightingale City[/b]

Humanity’s last stronghold is besieged. The Fae and their formidable Automaton Queen have unleashed chaos, and it falls to you to reclaim our home. Leap across rooftops, clear enemy-infested streets house by house, and explore the intricate network of sewers beneath the city.

Fight your way through three massive city quadrants, confront Bound invasions head-on, close the dangerous Transepts, and activate Pale Pylons to regain control. Your bravery and skill will be tested like never before when you face the fearsome Automaton Queen herself.

[b]Feature Highlights[/b]

Alongside the City, there have been improvements to our building system, as well as, new Gear and Fabled Charms!

[b]Enhanced Building & Customization[/b]

[list]
[*] Structure rotation and placement has been refined with more options
[*] Outfits, and Furniture: The update adds a Western-themed Frontier Tileset, Wrangler Outfit, and new furniture sets for the Crude and Tudor tilesets.
[*] Defensive structures can be obtained in the city. 
[*] New Furniture available
[/list]

[b]Powerful Gear & Fabled Charms[/b]

Tier 5 weapons and tools can be purchased with a new currency you can earn in Nightingale City. These weapons and tools have new components and recipes to allow for greater parametric crafting power.
[list]
[*] Tier 5 weapons and tools can now receive 2 charms
[*] Tier 5 weapons have unique visual treatment options both in crafting and in glamour	
[*] Tier 5 Fabled Charms can be purchased with the new currency.
[/list]

Fabled charms will make fantastic changes to the behaviours and powers associated with your weapons and tools. You can earn these as rewards in Nightingale City.

[b]Live Bug Fixes
[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in online mode where the incorrect tier of dye was sometimes applied.
[*] Fixed Tudor Shelf to allow object placement on its shelves.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the Porter Pistol from appearing in the glamour station for customization.
[*] Fixed the Red Cross Knight's Cuirass Gear to include a customizable shell region.
[*] Fixed a quest issue where party members retained "Build transept" after passing through another player's transept to NGC.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Boss Rush quest completion when in a party.
[*] Boosted comfort values for beds.
[*] Fixed dye previews to ensure consistency with their final appearance.
[*] Fixed an issue where LB/RB were double-bound on crafting stations.
[*] Fixed an issue allowing players to use the map to travel to a loadstar.
[*] Fixed wood harvested from stumps initially appearing with a default texture before correcting itself.
[*] Fixed the party screen not updating immediately when a player joins.
[*] Fixed the issue where Immolation and Blast Miners Trap shared the same icons.
[*] Fixed missing health bars above fish.
[*] Adjusted aim-down-sights for the Mystic Slingbow to align with projectile trajectory.
[*] Ensured font styles now meet Steam Deck requirements.
[*] Added gamepad support for the Essence Trader shop screen.
[*] Improved gamepad navigation on the map.
[*] Fixed issues with the consumable radial menu when using a gamepad.
[*] Fixed an issue where changing Make Up color after using the 'Reset' button did not apply the change.
[*] Fixed an issue where resetting EYES>DETAILS did not reset SCALE and DETAIL sliders properly.
[*] Fixed defense encounters being startable while the Extraction Device was destroyed.
[*] Fixed Eyelash Extensions resetting back to 66% regardless of user input.
[*] Fixed Focal Shards incorrectly being usable in the same slots as cut gems, and Hybrid Stone replacing stone blocks.
[*] Fixed the Reset button in the Hair Colour menu not functioning correctly.
[*] Fixed "Reset All" button altering the displayed hair color incorrectly.
[*] Fixed Eyelash Tip Colour changing unexpectedly after editing in the Appearance menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Nightingale Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[b]Nightingale Anniversary Update
[/b]Nightingale has officially reached its one-year milestone, and we’re here to celebrate with our next update. From a new dyes and customization system to tilesets and long-awaited bug fixes, this update brings plenty to help with your adventures in the Realms. 

[b]Dyes and Customization 
[/b]One of the most anticipated features is finally here: dyes and customization! As added functionality to the Glamour Station, you now have the ability to change the materials and colors of your clothing, gear, and weapons. As soon as you unlock this station, you can start customizing.

Here’s how it works:
[list][*]When you acquire an item with a specific characteristic that impacts its appearance, that characteristic is permanently unlocked at the Glamour Station.
[/*][*]For example, if you obtain an item with the Gold characteristic, you’ll be able to apply Gold to metals in the dye system from that point forward.
[/*][*]This system does not work retroactively, so you’ll need to obtain new items or pick up items you already have with desired characteristics to unlock their appearances.
[/*][*]For endgame players who’d rather not chase down every material, bundles of appearances are available at the Clothing Vendor in The Watch.[/*][/list][b]New Tilesets, Outfits, and Furniture
[/b]This update also expands building and fashion options with a new Western themed set:
[list][*]Frontier Tileset – A rugged new aesthetic for those seeking a bold frontier style.
[/*][*]Wrangler Outfit – A stylish new look fit for any adventurer.
[/*][*]New Furniture Sets – Enhance your homestead with additional pieces for the Crude and Tudor tilesets.[/*][/list][b]NPC Card Game 
[/b]Looking for a break from exploring the Realms while earning some Essence? Just speak to any of the NPC Survivors to play a match card mini-game where you can bet and win Essence.

[b]Bug Fixes and Quality-of-Life Improvements
[/b]Here are some of the most notable improvements from this update:
[list][*]Fireplaces now stay lit but only consume fuel when actively crafting.
[/*][*]Fixed flickering and blown-out VFX, providing a more visually stable experience.
[/*][*]Controller fixes: LT/RT are no longer double-bound to the Estate Cairn screen.
[/*][*]Improved Portal Meshes: No more squashed platforms when adjusting height.
[/*][*]Lancaster guns now deal proper secondary ability damage.
[/*][*]Essence Trader in Welkin’s Reach no longer gets stuck in an endless question loop.
[/*][*]No more spontaneous umbrella drops! Stay airborne as intended.
[/*][*]Quest NPCs now behave properly, without floating grenades or potions.
[/*][*]Correct climbing animations when injured.
[/*][*]Unique crust effects on tools and weapons now work correctly.
[/*][*]Smoother sprinting mechanics, even when moving toward the camera.
[/*][*]Missing quest markers fixed: The “Talk to Nicolas” marker now appears correctly.
[/*][*]Firearms no longer obscure vision when using Emotes.
[/*][*]Predator and Prey leather/hide tiers fixed.
[/*][*]Improved visual variety: Each tier of plant fiber now has a distinct appearance.
[/*][*]Harpy and Ishmael fibers now feature their proper creature appearances.
[/*][/list]

notes.title: Nightingale: Unreal 5.4 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Nightingale: Unreal 5.4 Update[/h1]

Today we've put out a new update that upgrades Nightingale to Unreal 5.4, as well as bug and quality of life fixes. 

[h2]Highlights[/h2][list][*][b]Engine Upgrade:[/b] Updated to Unreal Engine 5.4.
[/*][*][b]Character Customization:[/b] Improved the appearance of lipstick; you may need to re-edit lipstick in the character creator.
[/*][*][b]Gameplay Mechanics:[/b]
[/*][list][*]Reduced stealth attribute on gear for better balance with other attributes.
[/*][*]Removed structural support requirements, allowing objects to float when building.
[/*][*]Campfires and other fueled structures now turn off automatically after crafting is complete.
[/*][/list][*][b]Gamepad Updates:[/b]
[/*][list][*]Improved gamepad for the Map, Guidebook, Estate Cairn and Automation screens.
[/*][/list][*][b]Visual Updates:[/b]
[/*][list][*]Unique models added for Spyrus Mushrooms.
[/*][*]Hero creatures' appearances now match clothing customization.
[/*][/list][*][b]Building and Crafting:[/b]
[/*][list][*]Copy, move, and remove functionalities added to Build Advanced Mode.
[/*][*] Reduced time and effort required to craft T2 and T3 crafting benches.
[/*][/list][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][b]UI and Menus[/b]:
[/*][list][*]Player map markers now display on top of other markers.
[/*][*]Fixed the augments screen in Build Mode being completely blank.
[/*][*]Various fixes to the Party menu not functioning correctly.
[/*][*]Chat window now opens properly when activated during fade-out.
[/*][*]Minor cards on Realmic Transmuter now display tooltips on hover.
[/*][*]Container permission buttons now correctly highlight after changes.
[/*][*]Logging out and returning with an item in the crafting queue no longer displays a negative timer.
[/*][*]"Move Estate Center" button now remains active after closing and reopening the cairn menu.
[/*][/list][*][b]Gameplay and Mechanics:[/b]
[/*][list][*]Players no longer get stuck on the loading screen when playing Boss Rush.
[/*][*]Fixed issues with fueling campfires and crafting timers for better reliability.
[/*][*]Players no longer slide on the ground while in deep water.
[/*][*]Grenades no longer cause net corrections when knocking players back.
[/*][*]NPCs no longer get stuck or stop moving after teleporting to an automation station.
[/*][*]NPCs no longer rest in incomplete beds.
[/*][*]Fixed launcher and rifles reloading incorrectly.
[/*][*]Fixes for crosshairs being off-center.

notes.title: Nightingale: Winter Holiday Update
notes.content:
Our server maintenance has concluded and our servers are now back online.

Please update your game to ensure you can access Online Mode once again. The below items will not apply to the Offline Mode until you update the game.

It's recommended to restart Steam/Epic or verify your game files to make sure you're on the latest version. The game version shows in the main menu when you start the game.

Watch the Winter Update Overview video here: [url=https://youtu.be/gVUp3JPgnic]Winter Update Trailer[/url]

As winter’s frost settles across the Faewilds, the season brings numerous new features, improvements, and festive surprises to Nightingale. With today’s Winter Update, there’s plenty to explore. Read on for the highlights of this magical winter season.

[b]
Player-Hosted Servers[/b]

Player-hosted servers are now available, offering greater flexibility in how you experience the realms with friends. Two new options await when starting the game: Host a Friend and Connect to a Friend.

[b]Key Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Characters are now shared between offline mode, hosting a friend, and connecting to a friend.
[*] Download your online characters to play on friends’ hosted servers.
[/list]

[b]Host a Friend:[/b]

[list]
[*] Select "Host a Friend" and enter a port number for players to connect.

[*] Confirm settings, choose or create a character.

[*] Share your IP address and port with connecting players (find your IP via tools like icanhazip.com).

[*] If connecting outside your LAN, forward port 7777 (or your selected port) on TCP and UDP from your router to your PC.

[/list]
[b]Connect to a Friend:[/b]

[list]
[*] Select "Connect to a Friend" and enter their IP address and port.

[*] Join their hosted game and play as usual, with the host managing realm travel approvals.
[/list]

[b]Resource Automation[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/403b1c49bae6850e1c7149743a069058d5391b3b.jpg[/img]

Automate resource harvesting for your Estate using recruited Survivors! This feature will continue to evolve with future updates.

[b]How It Works:[/b]

[olist]
[*] Recruit an NPC as a Survivor.

[*] Assign them as a Resident of your Estate.

[*] Build a Resource Automation Station.

[*] Assign an Estate Resident to the station.
[/olist]

[b]Recruiting a Survivor:[/b]

[list]
[*] Interact with Survivors to obtain their Calling Cards.

[*] View Calling Cards in the "Calling Cards" tab of your inventory.
[/list]

[b]Estate Cairn Management:[/b]

[list]
[*] Access the Estate Management menu from the Estate Cairn.

[*] Assign up to 15 Survivors per Estate by upgrading your Cairn in the Progression menu (one Cairn per realm).
[/list]

[b]Automation Stations:[/b]

Choose from the following Resource Automation Stations in the Progression menu:

[list]
[*] Wood Station
[*] Mining Station
[*] Hunting Station
[*] Farming Station
[/list]

Assign a Resident to collect resources. Only Tier 1 resource stations are available in this update, with more to come.

[b]Winter Event[/b]

Celebrate the season with festive challenges and holiday-themed rewards! Check the Special Event tab in the Progression menu for unlock requirements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/1b0bcd6118a4617ebae383ebb10a44c765b06b23.jpg[/img]

[b]New Weapon:[/b]

Snowballs: Unlockable via the Progression tree and craftable at the simple workbench. Use the Charm of the Brawler to enable friendly fire for snowball fights.

[b]New Outfits & Decorations:[/b]

[list]
[*] Jolly Dress
[*] Winter Child’s Garb
[*] Magician Top Hat
[*] 16 festive estate decorations
[/list]

[b]New Food Recipes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Roasted Seeds
[*] Pumpkin Pie
[*] Spiced Latte
[/list]

[b]New Pet:[/b]

[list]
[*]Grimalkin
[/list]
[b]
New Snow-Themed Minor Cards:[/b]

[list]
[*] Cozy Winter Card: A peaceful snowy realm.
[*] Winter Wonderland: Increased gliding speed and height, with slippery ground.
[*] Naughty and Nice List: Creatures will drop coal and presents.
[/list]

[b]Improved Build Mode[/b]

Building has never been easier or more immersive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/11acb417c430583fa590f41e539fe8fc75d37f93.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Press “B” to enter Build Mode.
[*] Switch between Search Mode (advanced functionality) and Free Mode (immersive building).
[*] Customize crafting benches via the Station Traits tab to apply desired Augments.
[/list]
[b]
New Spells[/b]

Harness the power of the arcane with three new spells:

[list]
[*] Darkness: Create a shadowy orb that inflicts increased damage.
[*] Grasping Mire: Summon tentacles that slow and damage enemies.
[*] Life Drain: Absorb health from enemies to heal yourself.
[/list]

[b]Ring Course[/b]

Test your gliding skills with four new ring-gliding courses added to the Abeyance realm and Sylvan’s Cradle.

[b]New Tileset[/b]

A festive Obsidian Tileset is now available in The Watch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/d06499dcec161e953c6ea0f0c6fbd472e4aa66cf.jpg[/img]

[b]Additional Change Highlights[/b]

[list]
[*] Public Realm chat enabled.
[*] Fixed performance drop on Glamour Station.
[*] Resolved broken lighting on chandeliers.
[*] Charm of Brawling refresh issue fixed.
[*] Fixed hunger bar reset bug after eating food.
[*] Small violet flowers now count as “flower” resources and can be grown.
[*] Improved placement rules for ramps and planks.
[*] Fixed incorrect animation for bolt-action rifle aiming.
[*] Fabled Humbaba meat now spawns in Swamp Vault reward chests.
[*] The cold status effect is removed when players are sheltered.
[*] Resolved stuttering when wading in swamp water.
[*] Double-clicking clothing no longer unequips similar items.
[*] Players animate when using CapsLock for Auto Walk.
[*] NPCs retain health when changing areas.
[*] Improved collision resets for Sentinels and Sheliak in Boss Rush.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]

While the Winter Update brings many enhancements, some issues remain under investigation:
[list]
[*] Quests in the journal are shown as Nightingale cards.
[*] NPCs with blocked beds may get stuck wandering.
[*] Resolution change confirmation timer doesn’t work.
[*] On player-hosted servers, Eotens may float into the sky.
[*] Toggling the HUD hides boss health bars permanently.
[*] Inventories don't recognize controller focus until either Sort or transfer all are used (or mouse click/tap)
[/list]

notes.title: Nightingale: Autumn Update
notes.content:
Our server maintenance has concluded and our servers are now back online.

Please update your game to ensure you can access Online Mode once again. The below items will not apply to the Offline Mode until you update the game.

It's recommended to restart Steam/Epic or verify your game files to make sure you're on the latest version. The game version shows in the main menu when you start the game.

Details on the update below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/44bbc3486fb0874af879154a92eb75b0c17f5cbe.png[/img]

Greetings, Realmwalkers!

As the amber glow of autumn skies fade, the chilling breath of winter creeps through the Faewilds. Yet, before the icy grasp takes hold, the Realms promise one final offering of the season. 

Arriving today, Nightingale’s Autumn Update brings a number of new features for intrepid Realmwalkers to explore. 

To celebrate the update, Nightingale will also be 40% off on Steam! There's never been a better time to jump into the Realms. 

Check out the gameplay overview video below:

[previewyoutube=b-6CHTCjFPU;full][/previewyoutube]

This new update also draws to a close the Halloween Event. But no need to fear about missing out on any of the event items. They’ve been added to the Progression Tree. 

[h3]More Details:[/h3]

[h3]Boss Rush[/h3]
You’ll be able to find the new Boss Rush challenge in The Watch. Here, you’ll be able to fight an endless series of bosses, which will each have a random Minor Realm Card effect applied. Every boss you defeat increases the difficulty of the next. 

Your reward for facing this gauntlet are new Tier 5 and Tier 6 Infusions, as well as a whole swathe of new fabled resources. Do you have what it takes to survive?

[h3]New Weapons[/h3]

[b]Swords[/b]
[list]
[*] Swords are now available in Nightingale! You can progress through the entire game with a new sword for each tier.
[*] Primary attack is a three-part combo including two slashes and a thrust.
[*] Secondary skill is a parry/riposte, allowing the player to parry an attack, and then complete a very powerful riposte lunge attack.
[/list]

[b]Bow Magic Arrows[/b]
The Autumn Update introduces three new types of magic arrows for the bows!
[list]
[*] Entangle Arrows: Arrows that entangle enemy legs with brambles to slow their advance. (Careful there are diminishing returns!)
[*] Implosion Arrows: Arrows that carry a delayed detonation to your enemy.
[*] Slicing Arrows: A dual arrow volley connected by a magical garrote that slices enemies.
[/list]

[b]Launcher[/b]
[list]
[*] The last new weapon in the Autumn Update is a new alternative for the slingbow: the Launcher!
[*] The launcher is a multiple projectile weapon, capable of being loaded with many explosive marbles at once.
[*] This allows the player to quickly single fire with the primary fire, or use the secondary fire to crank up a large volley of marbles at once.
[/list]

[h3]FSR Frame Generation[/h3]
AMD's FSR3 Frame Generation has been added as a new option to increase framerate. This feature allows your graphics card to generate additional frames through interpolation, which should significantly improve framerate; however some users may notice some input latency and subtle visual artifacts. FSR Frame Generation should be available on most hardware, and and can also be used in conjunction with any of the upscalers (TSR, FSR, DLSS, or XeSS).
Because the underlying Frame Generation systems from AMD and Nvidia can't be enabled at the same time, users who have access to DLSS Frame Generation won't see the option to enable FSR Frame Generation. If you have an Nvidia 4000 series card and would like to try running with FSR Frame Generation, you can force DLSS Frame Generation to turn off by adding this in the Launch Options in Steam's settings for Nightingale: -slnoswapchainprovider.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/44bbc3486fb0874af879154a92eb75b0c17f5cbe.png[/img]

Those are the big ticket items in today’s update. However, for information on smaller changes and updates, check out the other change highlights below:

[h3]Change Highlights[/h3]

[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hitting 0 ‘Hunger’ will no longer kill you
[*] Hitting 25% ‘Hunger’ will still reduce your maximum health, and that effect will worsen the closer you get to 0
[*] Resting no longer removes your timed buffs, including food buffs
[*] ‘Exposed’ and ‘Grit’ traits have been removed
[*] Oberon’s Bounty works on damaged nodes
[*] Fishing stats affect fish catch rate
[*] Skinning a creature on uneven terrain no longer results in SFX spam
[*] Bound Mortar and Snipers no longer ignore ‘Stealth’ rating
[*] Sun Giant will finish his attacks when he sometimes would not previously
[/list]

[h3]Events and Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Halloween Event is over but the reward items have been added to the Progression Tree
[*] Plank and ramp structures have been added to the Progression Tree
[*] Puck should spawn more reliably during quests
[*] 
[/list]
[h3]Inventory and Crafting[/h3]
[list]
[*] Major Cards are sorted ahead of Minor Cards in the inventory
[*] Using more than 9 types of fuel at the same time will no longer disrupt the station fuel display
[*] Repair cost should be displayed correctly in the inventory when players have 0 essence
[*] Fix for ‘Back’ option on any crafting bench closes the bench menu, instead of returning to the previous tab
[*] Fix for logging out and then returning to the game when an item is in the crafting queue will cause the timer to display a negative number
[*] Fix for offhand item is not hidden when reloading the revolver
[*] Various fixes for materials on clothing not properly changing with crafting
[*] Structure and environmental fixes
[*] Upon placing any Bhutan pillar on Bhutan T-support Pillar, the one above will no longer levitate in the air and appear empty inside
[*] 
[/list]
[h3]AI and NPC Behavior[/h3]
[list]
[*] Recruited survivors may repeatedly jump over the stairs several times in a row, damaging themselves with every jump
[*] Survivors can no longer be hit by characters' knife attacks
[/list]

[h3]General known issues:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hanging augments functionality does not work on the right side of certain windows
[*] Speeding through dialogue results in text stuttering with single letter
[*] Hollowed Moor - Danu's interaction area is very limited and covers only her legs
[*] All Minor Cards remove ‘Gloom’ effect
[*] Deep Fae Wilds, Tavern, Forge, Greenhouse and Quarry Minor Cards not behaving as expected
[*] Oberon's Bounty is not giving bonus yield to some resources despite indicating it in the spell's description
[*] Applying enchantment to tool moves it to a different hotbar slot
[*] Fired arrows do not hit where player aims in 3P
[*] Special life bar of Azazel the Penitent might not be displayed after being downed and going back to them
[*] Remapping the interact key makes it so the prompt no longer displays a key
[*] Crafting station's traits slots may become empty upon player's return to the Realm
[*] Crude Portal might become unavailable when moving the blueprint near structures
[*] Stairs can't be placed upwards off floors
[*] Chests ended up in a bad persisted state when moving long distances
[*] Toggling the HUD on and off will permanently hide a boss health bar
[*] Climbing Picks have less range when in third-person camera mode
[/list]

[h3]Boss Rush Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Puck will appear the first time you collect a Synchronous Lotus when he shouldn’t
[*] Pressing “Return to Crossways” on the map will get your character stuck, quit and reload into that character via the main menu to continue
[/list]

notes.title: November Developer Q&A
notes.content:
Greetings, Realmwalkers!

Last week we jumped into Discord and answered questions from the community. Couldn’t make it? Fear not - we’ve got you covered. Our panel for this Q&A:

[list]
[*] Aaryn Flynn, CEO
[*] Neil Thompson, Director of Art and Head of Audio
[*] Leah Summers, Head of Production
[*] Michael Carter, Lead Designer
[*] Scarbs, Community/Question Asker
[/list]

Take a look at the edited transcript below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/44bbc3486fb0874af879154a92eb75b0c17f5cbe.png[/img]

[b]Scarbs:[/b]  Hey everyone! Thanks for coming along. Let’s start with the first question: What are the priorities for Nightingale’s development in the months ahead? 

[b]Aaryn: [/b]The most immediate thing we're doing is we've got an update we're targeting for the end of the month here, which is going to preview our listen server functionality. This is going to let you all play the game without having to connect to one of our hosted servers. That's been a long-standing requested feature.That will be in preview, meaning you'll be able to connect to it with some console commands and try it out at the end of the month here, and then we'll keep working on it. 

I should also say, as well as that, we've also got some fun new gameplay stuff coming too. We’ll talk more about that at a later date. Although, I will say that we have a sword coming.

[b]Michael:[/b] We do have a sword coming! As well as an alternate for the Slingbow.

[b]Aaryn: [/b]We struggled to think of the sword as a Victorian-era weapon. Hence, we didn't prioritize it, but so many folks wanted it, and we're able to do it. So the the sword is coming.

[b]Scarbs:[/b] Big reveals happening! Okay, so next question, what's the state of the new tilesets and rounded and corner pieces that were mentioned previously? 

[b]Neil:[/b] We have multiple new tilesets coming. I'm not sure which drop when but we're putting them in soon.

[b]Leah: [/b]We're just prepping them. They'll probably come closer to the holiday. So that's really exciting. We recently did an update to the structure system that allows you to build without support - that’s been really exciting! We’ve been enjoying  seeing what everyone's been doing with that new functionality. And then after we kind of get the new tilesets going, we'll start to look at the curved pieces and the other pieces. So not before the holiday, unfortunately, but we are absolutely going to get you a new tileset for sure.

[b]Neil:[/b] So we've got a Herbarium tileset that is based on the Crystal Palace, which is coming in Nightingale City. There is a Western tileset which is super cool. And, most excitingly, I think there is a Fae tileset coming as well, which is very exotic, but still fits with any existing tileset. So you can build a quasi-human Fae estate, which will look awesome. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/b8b2e3a63245697ad3a1e815f2f01f2c21140f9d.jpg[/img]

[b]Aaryn: [/b]Someone is asking about decorations. I think you've got some more decorations on the hopper too, right?

[b]Leah:[/b] Yeah, we have a lot of decorations lined up. That's for sure.

[b]Aaryn:[/b] We're talking holiday, potentially for some of that stuff?

[b]Leah:[/b] For holiday, yeah. Lots of lots of new decor, lined up.

[b]Aaryn:[/b] Rugs? Not yet but we will make a note for rugs that's a good note.

[b]Scarbs:[/b] A bunch of questions have been coming in. Are there any plans to implement display armor? 

[b]Michael: [/b]No current plans. You or NPC is sort of your armor display for armor right now, but that's certainly something we could look at.

[b]Scarbs:[/b] Next up: any plans to expand augmentations?

[b]Neil:[/b] Potentially! We'd like to and we want to make the right choices there. We’re also looking at  

Improving the functionality of augmentations to allow you to assign different augments to different benches. That should be coming soon.

[b]Scarbs: [/b]Question: are we going to see items scattered around the world (bath tubs, sinks, etc) become functional items for players to use?

[b]Michael:[/b] We've talked about that stuff. It could be like an augment or something you use to furnish your house. But no plans right now. 

[b]Aaryn: [/b]I see a question about having multiple NPCs.  Yeah, that's actually in the works, and so some of that will be coming - hopefully sooner rather than later. We really enjoy expanding the NPC gameplay, and so we want to do more and more with that over the course of the next, you know, two updates I would say.

[b]Scarbs:[/b] Someone is asking about whether we can extend the Halloween event... I don't think we said when that's ending. 

[b]Leah:[/b] That will come down with our next update towards the end of the month. However, we will leave all of the rewards in the tech tree so that you can still claim them.

[b]Aaryn:[/b] Yeah, it's a tough one, right? Because, on the one hand, you want to incentivise and reward players who make it on time. But on the other side of it, everybody hates missing out on the stuff. And so it seems like, in general, it's just better to always have this content accessible to people who missed it. And, yeah, it's totally FOMO, right? It feels awful to be like, “Why does that person have that cool hat? Oh, because they were there for this.” Our current thought process is to keep that stuff available. It’ll be available in some tier unlock.

[b]Scarbs:[/b] It's been asked a lot: the ability to actually sit on chairs…

[b]Aaryn: [/b]Not in the immediate future, but we are working on tech that will allow us to do that.

[b]Scarbs:[/b] We've got the Pawn, the Rook, Bishop and Knight Automatons, and the remains of a Queen Automaton. Will we see a King Automaton? 

[b]Aaryn: [/b]Things are worse than Queens, though? How would you fight a King? The Queen is being worked on right now. The Queen's getting a lot of love in various corners of the studio, so I think that'll be out, probably not this year, but certainly early next year. But I don't think we have any plans for a King right now - although I appreciate the completionists in this chat.

[b]Michael:[/b] The original design for the Queen involved you having to fight the King, which was a smaller creature. 

[b]Scarbs:[/b] Can players get crop plots that have snap points?

[b]Aaryn: [/b]That’s a good note. Let’s make an action item to make that happen. 

[b]Scarbs:[/b] There’s also a question asking for the ability to place seeds from the hotbar (rather than through the menus)...

[b]Michael:[/b] Farming is something we want to tackle as an update. It's taking a backseat to other concepts we're working on right now. It is on our list of things to improve, along with some fishing updates as well - more cozy gameplay focus in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/29d70a0f137cd55d3d4de1b7271af80d43ec4bbd.png[/img]

[b]Scarbs:[/b] More feature requests: any plans to improve the organization of augmentations, so you can figure out easily how augments affect different benches?

[b]Aaryn: [/b]There's an augmentation overhaul coming soon. Our current thought process is that you should be able to select the argument you want to affect certain benches, as long as within range. That should help. There’s still work being done there though.

[b]Scarbs:[/b] Cool. Any chance of implementing individual loot drops?

[b]Aaryn: [/b]Instance loop drops, I think, is what you mean by that? So the boss loot is instanced. So you know, when you do a Vault or when you do a story boss, those are currently instanced. Everyone gets their own drop of that. That doesn't mean we can't pursue it on other creatures at this point. We haven't, but it's, it's not outside of the realm of possibility, but not something we’re currently pursuing.

[b]Scarbs: [/b]Are there any plans to enhance chat features, making role-playing easier? Having multiple channels in chat, the ability to move the chat window, and stuff like that...

[b]Aaryn: [/b]Nothing at this time. But it's a good note. We can look into it. 

[b]Scarbs: [/b]And are you guys planning to update the character creator dashboard? Because there's a bunch of stuff still in there, obviously, which is coming soon. What are the plans for that?

[b]Neil: [/b]Yeah, there are some bits and pieces that we want to tie off, specifically around things like makeup and possible tattoos and things like that. So, yeah, we'll continue to work on that. 

I keep seeing Kahz posting the same question, so we should probably answer that one. It’s asking about more playable content in terms of biomes and so forth. The big next release in that regard will be Nightingale City. 

[b]Aaryn: [/b]That will be end-game content. We are also talking about adding another end-game piece of content in this next update, or the one after that. Basically, over the next two updates we will be dripping new end-game stuff for players.  

[b]Neil:[/b] I think the City will be awesome as well. I guarantee it. That’s my personal guarantee.

[b]Aaryn:[/b] Answering a question in chat: no, the next biome isn’t winter. The original vision for the game was to have unique biomes and unique locations.  And so winter being a season, ideally, winter can come to any kind of biome, right? I guess you could argue about desert… but the point is, we want to separate out the idea of biomes and seasons. So we are doing some work on seasons right now. So stay tuned for that, and you should see some cool stuff coming that way by the wintertime. Hint, hint, nudge nudge. Hint…

[b]Scarbs: [/b]Is there any movement or update on mounts or vehicles? We've talked about penny farthings, airships, etc.

[b]Michael: [/b]No major plans there. Hopefully, your umbrella is good at traversing and once you put the spec into it it’s fast enough for most players. But anyway, no plans right now.

[b]Scarbs: [/b]The game has a lot of visually distinct resource nodes and materials, as well as crafting recipes. Are there plans to make materials more visually cohesive to the raw ingredients with more visual vibrancy and variation? 

[b]Aaryn: [/b]There are some limitations around doing that, but we're also very keen to bring a higher degree of control with item customization at some point in the future, which will allow for this kind of more unique connection between the refined resource and the thing that you actually craft with it.

[b]Scarbs:[/b] Here’s a question: will you add the ability to override a building piece without demolishing the pieces?

[b]Aaryn: [/b]Oh, we've talked about this, yeah. Just swapping one wall in for another.

[b]Neil: [/b]That should be in the new update.

[b]Leah: [/b]Yeah. That one is in the new build update. It won't have, I think someone asked about, like, wallpapers or painting. No, but we've, we've started with being able to swap things out on the fly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/fd7647c93b94acd9afa9d3a6a0f90ea737f30476.jpg[/img]

[b]Scarbs:[/b] Will further clothing customization be acded in the future?

[b]Aaryn: [/b]The Glamor Bench was kind of the start of this process, but we're just going to keep going with that so that you can customize it more. One of the things we did on the dev side very early on, was we were able to go in and individually change the colors of the threads. We’re hopefully  going to find a way of allowing players to do that too, because it is incredibly fulfilling. 

[b]Neil: [/b]And that functionality would be on the glamor bench or glamor station. Sorry, when it comes.

[b]Scarbs: [/b]We have one of the tough questions come in, so it's worth answering now, and we can sort of dig back into the gameplay stuff. After the news that we had reductions to the studio size, does that mean more focus on specific projects instead of spread out? Will bigger updates take longer to come, or would be more, smaller updates? Basically, an update to the state of play…

[b]Aaryn:[/b] Obviously, it should go without saying, we're really sorry to lose so many folks from the studio. They're all amazing developers. They're all super talented. So that part makes it so hard when we have to say goodbye to friends and colleagues, and sometimes folks we've known for, you know, a very long time, right? And hopefully we're all still friends outside of work. So that's that is the hard news. And again, there's no changing that. 

I guess there are two ways to look at where we go from here. One is that we still have a healthy number of folks contributing to Nightingale right now, and it's now incumbent on us too, and I think this is what you were alluding to Scarbs, is have them focus on only the most important things. Nightingale is a very broad game. It's sometimes broader than it is deep, and we want to add depth to the places that we now have confidence you're all enjoying, or other people are enjoying. That's things like the combat and then the building/estate management. Those are the two big areas, and both of those can also then be connected to the end game content that folks have been alluding to. Nightingale City is the element of that. And so that becomes our job as development leaders is to focus our team on the most important things, and those are the two things. 

[b]Scarbs: [/b]Asking something tangentially related, moving forward, how will the studio balance feedback on the website and Aha, particularly topics that don’t get as much engagement as others? How do you balance, you know, what's important through all that feedback?

[b]Leah: [/b]We actually put a lot of stock into the feedback. This week, we spent over two hours going through it with some members of the team to make sure we had heard the feedback. Maybe it was filed in our backlog, we tried to update the statuses on the AHA board. I mean, there's lots in there, so it's obviously challenging to get through everything. But, you know, we are, we are always looking and trying to be on top of it as best as possible.

[b]Aaryn:[/b] We should probably respond to the question from Lazarus there about like Nightingale closing down, right? There is zero intention for us to close Nightingale down. You're hearing it from us that we are continuing to work on Nightingale, and part of the reason we made the changes to the studio that we did was to enable us to continue to work on Nightingale and to support it in the long term. There's 134 people in this audience. You are all evangelists for Nightingale. I assume otherwise you wouldn't be here. So spread the word!

[b]Neil: [/b][Addressing chat question about Marc Warren still voicing Puck] Yes, Mark Warren will be voicing pop for new content. 

[b]Leah:[/b] He’s in the booth right now!

[b]Neil: [/b]Someone was asking about half-wall pieces for the Regency set. You know, if we could set up a discord channel where people ask for extra pieces based on the tilesets that already exist, I would happily go through that and build them.

[b]Scarbs: [/b]We'll move on from the studio-based questions. We'll go with a nice, easy one. I think I know the answer to this question. Will we get magic arrows like we have magic ammunition?

[b]Aaryn[/b]: It's been worked on as we speak. But they will be a bit different than the magic ammo we have. They'll be more exciting, hopefully.

[b]Scarbs: [/b]Are there going to be more co-op quests and, you know, multiplayer-related material or will future updates be solo-orientated?

[b]Aaryn: [/b]That's a good question. You know, obviously, we look at the metrics and the analytics, and we see most people are either solo or with asynchronous co-op. We want to make sure that the vast majority, if not all, of the content that we make is enjoyable when you're solo and in multiplayer. 

The dream for Nightingale was always to do strictly multiplayer content, right? That's what we had a lot of fun imagining. I mean, there's four people in this room right now who play this game together, and we have a lot of fun when we do so. And so we like the idea of this, but, but, you know, truly when we do that kind of content, we often get conflicting statements being made, like “Oh, I don't play that way” “I can't enjoy that.” “That's not fair. You're not prioritizing the things that I want to work on,” etc. So we definitely feel we have to strike a balance there and figure out how to, how to kind of make that work for everybody. And so generally, what we do is we try to make everything possible with solo play.

But I would love to make strictly, you know, three-person, six-person content, and say, You got to group up, and you got to do that, because I have a lot of fun when I play the game that way, right? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/7d269a06c2109e54b8ae2019f7df7cf6b12faaf7.jpg[/img]

[b]Scarbs: [/b]Are there plans for player factions, player guilds, like I just mentioned, larger Realm sizes, both in geography and in multiplayer, account social controls for Realms, loot separation, which came up earlier, and bosses that require multiple players to defeat, etc.?

[b]Aaryn:[/b] That's a lot…So I can, I can sort of speak to the intention of more multiplayer content. So once again, a lot of the current player base plays solo or offline, which means there's no chance of them even joining an online player environment. In terms of content, we're creating this new content around end game. The loose idea I'll give to you is it gets harder and harder, forever, until you die. Obviously, you can do that solo and have a good experience doing that, but if you want to take on super deep-end game content, you will want a group of six people doing that content, because that is how you're going to get as deep as possible. 

[b]Scarbs:[/b] Are there any plans with Vaults in terms of the size and shape and scope of them? More variations in puzzles, variations of previous bosses…

[b]Aaryn:[/b] The vaults are relatively untouched in the next update. Maybe in the future we can do more to add features. This new content we're talking about for the end game is sort of parallel. You'll be getting similar rewards, not exactly the same rewards. 

I don't want to prioritize the extroverts over the introverts. I respect the introverts, and I want to be able to play as much of the game as possible, if not all of it. But at the same time, we're also trying to say that people who want to play with their friends, they want to have content that they can enjoy together and that's cool, too. And so we have to figure out the balance to strike there. And so typically, the two things we consider are to make it available for solo players and then secondly, to consider interesting and novel ways that playing with your friends can make an experience better or different. And that's hard, that's a hard design problem.

[b]Scarbs:[/b] This question has been asked a couple of times: Will there be improved metadata on Realm Cards in the future? Make it easier to understand what Realm Cards are being played, which player owns then, and easier for players to share content with each other?  

[b]Aaryn: [/b]We looked into this on the UI side, and there are some technical, uh, issues that we need to sort out to let us do this. I can certainly take it back to the team. Some of that other metadata was a bit of a bridge too far a few of the times we looked into it, but we can definitely check again.

[b]Scarbs: [/b]I think I've seen some confusion from your answer earlier around listen servers. Can you give more clarity? Are they player dedicated servers?  

[b]Aaryn:[/b] So it's a step in that direction, right? So a listen server is a functionality that lets you play the equivalent to offline mode. So you're just playing by yourself. There's no outward network connection at all. But if a friend comes along and wants to join you, you can actually have them connect to your game and still have their character come over to your game. So, that's why they call that a listen server in the in the Epic/Unreal parlance.

Yeah, I bet Satisfactory does do this… I think many games do this, like Valheim.  Mikey, I bet does many, many games do this. But then from there, there's another step you can take which is called a dedicated server, which is where just the server binary runs on a box somewhere, and everybody can connect and disconnect from it and do that (which is actually how Nightingale works right now). You can use G Portal or Nitrado for that and pay for a hosted service that way. So this listen server functionality is a step in that direction.

[b]Scarbs: [/b]I’m going to pivot now back to sort of the granular feature questions and specifics. So will material appearance ever determine the appearance of structures such as, like you're building a house or a shack out of yew or hardwood and it reflects those resources? Also questions about being able to paint estate walls.

[b]Aaryn: [/b]Currently, you put any wood into any structure, right? So that would require some back end stuff - it would get pretty complicated pretty quickly in terms of how that would function. Setting up, a hammer, or something that can change those walls, is something more achievable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/8f6a8eceaa37d42bda93a4df71f8541335cb4f9f.jpg[/img]

[b]Scarbs: [/b]Someone's asking if we get more repeatable side missions or quests like more dungeons or things like base defence?

[b]Aaryn:[/b] it's been discussed in terms of both base defence has been discussed many times at the studio. It's a bit of work, and there are some questions to be answered with how that works with people getting the houses destroyed. But in terms of daily quests and stuff, that's not something we’re currently pursuing deeply. But as we talk about hiring NPCs, something along the lines of the longer your NPC is with you, they might give you a quest. Is something we are thinking about pursuing.

[b]Scarbs:[/b] Are there any efforts being made to reconcile the newly free-floating structures with the lore of the game?  So there's a bit of a controversy within the community right now that, now that we've removed the necessity to have pillars holding things up, estates can float around. Are we going to sort of contextualize that within the lore of the game?

[b]Neil: [/b]We didn’t have any plans to…

[b]Scarbs:[/b] You've got to think about it now.

[b]Neil:[/b] This is a tricky one, right? Because this comes down to a desire to allow players to express themselves creatively as they wish, with the tools that we provide them. We never initially had the idea of player-built floating structures. It was always much more physically based, right? You needed to have support. So we kind of find ourselves in a conflict with how do we allow players to express themselves? Moving those constraints, yeah, sure, you can have fun with it. Now we've got to figure out a reason for why that happens. I mean, I can give you one right now, off the top of my head, if you like, and then we can write it into lore.

[b]Scarbs: [/b]Maybe take a minute,

[b]Aaryn:[/b] The struggle then becomes if we put a justification in, if we say “this is the reason” the risk is that it becomes a point of friction. Like, maybe you have to get a unique tileset to do it, or you've got to have some spell to do it. So we went this way because it was the simplest. And it will probably end up staying this way because it's simple and clean and people ultimately have fun with it, even if they have to kind of look the other way briefly while they knock out a pillar.

[b]Neil:[/b] You could just say, you know, if you knock a pillar our the Fae winds will support you. Don't use that one. But we used to have things like this. If you remember, before Realms Rebuilt, you couldn’t put a spell on a weapon unless it was upgraded and that was a weird consideration we made. We ended up taking that out. We’ve always got to be careful with how we handle things like that.

[b]Scarbs:[/b] Speaking of spells, are we going to get more enchantments? Maybe non-combat orientated ones. 

[b]Aaryn:[/b] I can speak to that. Yes, more enchantments are coming. In terms of non-combat ideas, we were talking about a localized rain cloud. But we want to make sure that we have a clear distinction between spells and Minor Realms Cards - and we have a bunch of weather related Realm Cards. We don't want to cross over too much. But we are thinking about non-combat spells.

[b]Scarbs:[/b] Speaking of magic upgrades, are there any plans to make etched ingots have more stats than their standard ingot versions? It would be cool if etched, added magic or other cool attributes.

[b]Michael:[/b] Yeah, that is something we've talked about. So there's lots of discussion in terms of parametric crafting. Etching is one of those things where it's an upper level. Same thing with carbon wood. We are actually looking at those and their functionality and reviewing whether they should give an additive bonus. So we've talked about that, but there are challenges there.

[b]Scarbs:[/b] Are decorative only plants a possibility, such as hedge flowers, vines? 

[b]Neil:[/b] Yes! Why not. I was more taken with the question about non Euclidean estate building. What I'm assuming there from the question is that you want a scenario where there aren't stairways from room to room…yeah, there's a science fiction novel that I can't remember the name of, but it's based around that technology where a guy just has a house built on multiple planets, and each doorway is a portal. So it's bathrooms on an ocean world, and it's just a platform to meet…

So you could build an estate like that across multiple realms with with builder portals that would connect you to each room in your estate. That would be, I'm not sure if anyone's done that, but it would be pretty fabulous.

[b]Scarbs: [/b]With the idea of parametric crafting, will there be additions of  interchangeable part types with specific stats? So even more modular…

[b]Aaryn:[/b] That sort of already exists more as an accessibility feature than anything else, right? Often we call for cloth, but you can use durable cloth. So things like that are things we're pursuing - more alternatives are effectively possible. We have certain challenges with the system but in terms of, if we wanted to do more component parts, we could explore that.

[b]Scarbs: [/b]That's it for today. Thank you to everyone for coming along. I'll hand it back to Aaryn and co. to say their goodbyes.

[b]Aaryn:[/b] Thank you so much for your continued support. This is really fun to do. We actually really enjoy these things. We're really, really excited to just make some new stuff for you all, and have you enjoy it. 

[b]Michael: [/b]Thanks so much for what's my first time here. So thanks for being so welcoming.

[b]Leah:[/b] Thanks!

[b]Neil:[/b] Bye!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/44bbc3486fb0874af879154a92eb75b0c17f5cbe.png[/img]

And that’s it for this Q&A. Do you want to get involved in future live Q&As with the studio team? Jump into Discord here and look out for announcements on when we’ll be hosting the next one. 

The Nightingale Team

notes.title: Work on ambitious survival game Nightingale "will continue" despite dev layoffs
notes.content:
We've seen some huge survival game success stories this year - even some that were released with a healthy amount of jank and performance issues like Palworld. However, buried beneath the high-fliers is Nightingale - a gorgeous survival experience that has undergone some radical changes since its February launch, but one that is still struggling to attract players. As a result of the game's poor performance, developer Inflexion Games has confirmed that it is laying off dozens of staff. That said, it's still committed to working on Nightingale, which still remains in early access.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Changes to Technical Support and Troubleshooting Articles
notes.content:
Dear Realmwalkers,

Today we’re announcing a change to game troubleshooting and support. From today, we will no longer be using Zendesk to host troubleshooting articles and support tickets. 

If you are experiencing technical issues with Nightingale, please check out the new support section of our website (https://playnightingale.com/support) for common technical troubleshooting tips.

In the case basic troubleshooting does not resolve your issue, please check search in our Aha portal (https://playnightingale.ideas.aha.io/) to see if a similar post with the issue exists with additional steps or information needed to look into the issue further. If a similar post does not already exist, please submit a new post.

Thank you for your understanding as we go through this transition.

- The Nightingale Team

notes.title: Nightingale - Halloween Event
notes.content:
Greetings, Realmwalkers!

As the shadows stretch long and a chill grips the far corners of the Faewilds, Halloween awakens in the Realms for our latest community event. Mischief, malevolence and, of course, tricks and treats await Realmwalkers who take on the wretched new enemy that awaits in the dark. Watch the teaser below. 

[previewyoutube=HHSFoOjPcDM;full][/previewyoutube]

Are you ready to tackle Puck’s chilling challenge and face the fearsome new Night Bound for some spooky rewards? Jump into Nightingale from Wednesday 23rd October to participate in the ghoulish festivities. 

How do you access the Halloween event? The event will be live from Wednesday 23rd October at 10 am PST/11 am MST/6 pm BST and will run until our next update after Halloween (we'll post a date nearer the time). After the update is live, jump into the Forest Abeyance and you’ll be greeted by Puck with a new quest*. From there you’ll be given instructions on how to battle the Night Bound and earn themed rewards in your Progression tab, including pumpkins, graves, caskets and more. 

As the Realms celebrate Samhain and Hallowe'en, you’ll also be able to find festive decorations in The Crossways and the Abeyance Settlement (where Wilhelmina Sasse and Graeme Turner reside). Visit the Settlement to hear about the festivities from Wilhelmina, Graeme, and Taliesin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/49d0e5148ee8371ffe3cb47a97fbb957cadc1a4a.jpg[/img]

[i]*You’ll need to have completed the ‘Tools of the Trade’ quest to start the new questline[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/44bbc3486fb0874af879154a92eb75b0c17f5cbe.png[/img]

[h2]Here’s a full list of quests and rewards:[/h2]

Autumnal Reveler - Kill 25 Autumnal Bound - Unlocks Jack-o’-Lantern
Bountiful Merrymaker - Kill 150 Autumnal Bound - Unlocks Perched Jack-o’-Lanterns + Stacked Jack-o’-Lanterns
Gourd Harvester - Kill 250 Autumnal Bound - Unlocks Harvest Display
Hallowed Hunter - Kill 500 Autumnal Bound - Unlocks Sunflower Display + Pumpkin Bunch
Patron of Mischief - Kill 750 Autumnal Bound - Unlocks Gravestone Cluster + Casket
Samhain’s Guardian - Kill 1000 Autumnal Bound - Unlocks Jack-o’-Lantern Helmet

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/b8b2e3a63245697ad3a1e815f2f01f2c21140f9d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/44bbc3486fb0874af879154a92eb75b0c17f5cbe.png[/img]

As the Bound eyes watch with flickering flames from the shadows, and the rattle of bones echoes in the distance, we wish you good luck and fortune in your quest to rid the Realms of these haunted spirits. 

Until next time, fare thee well traveler.

notes.title: 0.5.3 Changelog | Server Maintenance Complete

Please update your game to ensure you can access Online Mode once again. The below items will not apply to the Offline Mode until you update the game.

It's recommended to restart Steam/Epic or verify your game files to make sure you're on the latest version. The game version shows in the main menu when you start the game.

notes.title: Victorian survival game Nightingale is about to get a major building upgrade
notes.content:
The future looks bright for Nightingale. It's never nice to see a game face a troubled launch, especially one as spectacular to look at as Inflexion Games' Victorian gaslamp fantasy world. Fortunately, the survival game has seen a gradual and continued recovery from its rocky start with the dramatic Realms Rebuilt overhaul, and it looks to have paid off. Now, it's focused on the future, and that starts with one big upgrade to base building as the developer returns to working on a larger city environment that reaches back to its original MMORPG roots.

Read the rest of the story...

Realmwalkers,

Our server maintenance has concluded and our servers are now back online.

Please update your game to ensure you can access Online Mode once again. The below items will not apply to the Offline Mode until you update the game.

It's recommended to restart Steam/Epic or verify your game files to make sure you're on the latest version. The game version shows in the main menu when you start the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/44bbc3486fb0874af879154a92eb75b0c17f5cbe.png[/img]

[h1]0.5.2 Changelog[/h1]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Progression Blockers[/h3][list][*]We had Sheliak's Yoke (Scarab boss) take some refresher courses so it should no longer lose aggro and become unresponsive
[/*][*]Renewed the magick in an inactive Desert Vault glyph so it should now work as intended and allow players to complete the puzzle
[/*][*]We’ve given Puck a stern talking-to, and he should appear more consistently when quests are complete, especially in Hollowed Moor
[/*][/list][h3]Art/Visual[/h3][list][*]Got the paints rematched so the Regency Tileset should now be the same colour in all Realms
[/*][*]A Desert Gauntlet Realm POI has had its setting dressing replaced, making it a good date spot despite the Bound nearby
[/*][/list][h3]Building[/h3][list][*]Turns out, plant pots and plots were haunted by vengeful tree spirits. We’ve cleansed them so invincible trees should no longer spawn near plant pots and planters. If you have this issue, please use Build Mode (default ‘X’ key) and completely remove cursed pots/plants. Try logging out (if playing in Online Mode, please wait 10+ minutes for the server to completely shut down) and then logging back in to see if it’s resolved. If it is, rebuild with your less cursed plant pots/plots
[/*][*]We “took care” of the Fae trickster that caused some Realmwalkers to come across invisible buildings, especially when returning to their Respite Realms
[/*][/list][h3]Crafting[/h3][list][*]Adding Charms to items should no longer reduce their gear score
[/*][/list][h3]NPCs[/h3][list][*]Pillars should no longer block Sheliak’s Yoke from spawning
[/*][*]Recruited NPCs no longer stop working if players sleep
[/*][/list][h3]Quests[/h3][list][*]Talked to Observatory management in Welkin’s Reach, it will now re-open if players reset the Realm and have completed the ‘Chasing for Stars’ quest
[/*][/list][h3]Resources[/h3][list][*]We took out the remaining supply of T4 Infusions rewards as they are past their expiry date and invalid
[/*][/list][h3]UI/UX[/h3][list][*]HP bars should now sync in multiplayer
[/*][*]The ‘Add Selected’ button in the Fuel Menu should now function as expected
[/*][/list][h2]Game Changes[/h2]
[h3]Art/Visual[/h3][list][*]Powered up all light sources to be brighter at night
[/*][/list][h3]NPCs[/h3][list][*]Nellie no longer requires the player to ask multiple questions to progress her dialogue.
[/*][*]Allan Quartermain will no longer cheap out on Essence, and reward T4 Essence instead of T3 Essence
[/*][*]Using the teleporter at Sites of Power will now respawn bosses as long as other players are not in the boss area
[/*][/list][h3]Player Character[/h3][list][*]Added the option for toggle sprint in the controls menu so players can press Shift to sprint as long as they have the stamina to do so
[/*][/list][h3]Misc[/h3][list][*]Realigned collision on Crossway glyphs
[/*][*]Increased collision on the Welkin’s Reach Hope Gate
[/*][*]Glyphs in the Abeyance Site of Power will no longer appear behind bustable walls, chests with rewards can now be found in such locations instead
[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/44bbc3486fb0874af879154a92eb75b0c17f5cbe.png[/img]

Thank you for your patience and for joining us on this journey!

- The Nightingale Team
