notes.title: Bound Minions: From Concept to Game - Interview with Neil Thompson
notes.content:
The most common Bound enemy that you’ll fight in Nightingale is The Bound Minion. They’ll be familiar to both experienced and novice Realmwalkers alike as the first type of Bound creature encountered in the Realms. While these lower-tier enemies are relatively easy to defeat individually, they can quickly overwhelm you in larger numbers. We’ve chosen to focus on these fiendish foes in this edition of our behind-the-scenes blog series, and to give us more insight into their creation, we've invited our Art Director, Neil Thompson, to shed some light on the design and lore behind these devilish grunts. 

Please let us know if you have any requests for specific Creature Features on Discord or the Forums!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]How did creating the Bound begin?[/b]
The Bound Minions were the first enemy type to be created. The original intention was that they would be a ‘popcorn’ fight without much strategic importance or difficulty. We wanted a starting point for future enemy types from a gameplay standpoint and art direction.

The initial design process started with sketches that evoked a type of horde army, with a signature look that would tie (pun intended) all future Bound archetypes together. We went through several rounds of concept designs before we finally hit on a look that we felt satisfied with.

[b]What inspired the lore behind the Bound? When did you know that you had the look for Bound?[/b]
The original idea for the Bound was, in retrospect, quite horrifying. Human prisoners were captured by the Fae and, through a ‘Binding Ceremony’, compelled to do their bidding. In this case: Kill All Humans. As a Realmwalker, your only defense was to use whatever tool was at hand to kill these poor unfortunates. Conscious and aware but unable to change their fate, it was a tremendously dark conceit that ultimately we moved away from as it didn’t sit well with the overarching tone of adventure that we believe Nightingale to be. So their back story changed so that they are now constructs of the Fae; grown in vats via magical means. You can feel much better about hitting them in the head with an axe now without the moral dilemma.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/2e8be4faeebb7941af39a3067efc2f8b1b059e49.png[/img]

This image by Casper Konefal was where we knew we now had the main themes for our Bound look. Even though we changed the origin from human to bestial in nature (as a result of the change in origin story), the visual language defined here became the lasting template that we still refer to today when starting any new Bound archetype.

[b]How did the early development of the Bound change their design?[/b]
The Bound Minions were the first enemy type we playtested with. The core idea of these enemies hasn’t changed much, but the art direction for The Bound took off from this point. We iterated off of some initial in-game models until we got to the Bound Minions that you see today. As development and playtesting continued, we evolved the Bound Minions into different enemy types. 

Looking at Nightingale today, the palette of distinct Bound types has now flourished into a diverse set of enemies that can operate independently or as a collaborative group.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/96ee55dcea18acea24a2d6e5db8a53a173eb40c7.jpg[/img]

[b]What is the object or goal of the Bound design? What story are you trying to tell?[/b]
The Bound are unified by their aggression and strange ligatures on their skin. The idea behind their evolution is that Minions become Bound Lanterns and other minion types. We wanted The Bound to have a unique bestial quality yet appear capable of metamorphosis into the tougher variants.When we moved away from the initial backstory, we wanted the Bound to signify a soulless appearance, propped up by Fae magic. While these enemies have a physical form, they are an enemy that powerful Fae have created to prevent Realmwalkers from growing in strength.

One thing will always remain true with any Bound archetype: to be Bound is to be in pain, hence the uncomfortable posing and binding of limbs. If it’s not uncomfortable, it’s not Bound.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thanks, Neil! That’s all for this behind-the-scenes blog! Stay tuned for more creature features!

To add your submissions, please create an account. Your name and email will not be visible to other portal viewers, but will be visible to Inflexion Games and player support administrators. All content on the platform is subject to our Code of Conduct.

notes.title: Nightingale Unplugged | Offline Mode Debut
notes.content:
[h2]Nightingale Unplugged | Offline Mode Debut[/h2]

We're thrilled to announce a major milestone in Nightingale’s Early Access journey: tomorrow we are debuting our highly-requested Offline Mode! This marks a significant addition in providing you, our dedicated players, with even more flexibility in how you enjoy your gaming experience.

First, here’s a note from Inflexion Games’ CEO, Aaryn Flynn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/68844cdaaac245da7a2778dba0aa296536b4feb7.png[/img]

We’ve covered a good amount of these details in our latest [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cZ-dkZsbWW4]Developer Update video[/url], but in case you missed it, or simply prefer it in writing, here’s everything you need to know.

[h2]Embrace the Freedom: Play Anytime, Anywhere‍[/h2]
With the introduction of Offline Mode, you're no longer tethered to an internet connection. Whether you're in a remote abode or simply facing spotty Wi-Fi, fear not! Nightingale's Offline Mode allows you to immerse yourself in the Faewilds without worrying about unreliable ISPs.

Concerned about our servers being taken out by localized sun flares? Well, worry about the scientific intricacies of that later as you’ll be able to keep on exploring the Realms in the meantime. Need to pause for a moment to tend to real-life matters? No problem! Pause at your leisure and return whenever you're ready to continue your adventure.

[h2]The Starting Line: What to Expect‍[/h2]
Our goal is to have as much parity between the online mode and the offline version of Nightingale. While we regard this as a “Version 1” of Offline Mode, all of the base game content, including new content arriving with 0.3, will be available in this mode. 

To experience Offline Mode, create a new character and jump into the Realms. If this isn’t your first Realm dive, you even have the option to skip the tutorial so you can jump right into your Abeyance!

You’ll be able to experience the Realms, play minor Cards, visit the Watch, take on Vaults, hunt Apex creatures and so much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/19783bfe3c406764adfc48c13dfa9458925fdafd.jpg[/img]

While Offline Mode brings more freedom for players, it's important to understand its limitations. Firstly, multiplayer functionality will not be available in this mode. With this mode being exclusively available in single-player, some content, such as Vaults, has been balanced for solo play. Additionally, certain features that rely on connecting to a player account such as rewards (including Twitch Drops), won't be accessible for offline players.

The team has put in tremendous effort to decouple the server load onto your local PC, but this does mean your PC will need to work a little harder in Offline Mode. Work is being done for further performance optimization, but in the meantime, you may need to reduce a couple of settings down a level for similar game performance as the online mode. With that said, we don’t foresee major changes to our technical requirements or minimum specs at this time.

[h2]A Word on Modding[/h2]
We understand that many of you are passionate about modding and customizing your gaming experiences! While we understand the value that mods bring to games, we won't officially support modding at this time. After we fully understand how Offline Mode is performing in its current iteration, we’ll evaluate how we can support mods in a more official capacity.

As we’re unable to verify the safety of external mods, we won’t be endorsing mods on our official platforms such as Discord for now. But if you choose to mod your Offline Mode characters, we kindly ask that you disclose this when sharing your experiences online.

[h2]Conclusion: The Dawn of a New Era[/h2]
We want to stress that this is just the beginning of our journey with Offline Mode. As such, we will be continuously refining and improving the experience based on your feedback.

While we acknowledge that there's still work to be done and improvements to be made, we're excited about the possibilities that lie ahead. We’re already working on the ability to transfer existing characters from online mode to Offline Mode, Steam Deck compatibility, and Cloud Save capability as well as improving performance - and we look forward to hearing from you regarding additional features you’d like to see!

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. Your feedback is invaluable as we strive to make Nightingale the best it can be. So, go forth, brave Realmwalkers, and enjoy the wonders of the Offline Mode!

The Nightingale Team

notes.title: Community Event | A Spark of Hope
notes.content:
Realmwalkers,

In the wake of the devastating Pale engulfing the Earth which caused humanity to find refuge in the mystical Realms, a glimmer of hope has emerged.

As humans flooded into the Realms, leaving behind the shadows of their past, newfound optimism for their future in the Faewilds began to grow. Previously quite rare, Hope manifested in quantities never before seen, affecting the Realms' denizens in mysterious ways. The Fae Wisps, ever curious and eager to absorb such potent fervor, danced amidst the burgeoning Hope, absorbing tiny sparks of it. Over time, these sparks coalesced and crystallized into a new type of Fae Essence, shimmering with the promise of possibility and renewal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/85ac82f5f59358b8e34707cc7d33cede660321a2.jpg[/img]

Dubbed "Hopeful Essence," this newfound resource quickly captured the attention of denizens across the Realms. Essence traders, always on the lookout for the latest trends and rarest finds, are scrambling to acquire this precious commodity, eager to capitalize on its potential.

Here's a glimpse into the unique wares offered by these enterprising Abeyance Realm traders:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/0a0be5940a67fc30895742392f965da02bc73988.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Stave Table (Estate Decoration)
[*] Carved Stave Chair (Estate Decoration)
[*] Stave Brazier (Estate Decoration)
[*] Dual Drinking Horns (Estate Decoration)
[*] Skull Stand (Estate Decoration)
[*] Creature Trophy (Estate Decoration)
[*] Sentinel’s Set (Clothing)
[*] Hunter’s Hat (Clothing)
[*] Scarves (Clothing)
[*] Black Pudding (Food)
[/list]

This surge of human optimism will not last for long. The event starts once Update 0.3 goes live on Wednesday, 22 May, so ensure you acquire the goods of your choosing before the next major Realm update (0.4).

notes.title: Creator Spotlight: Kiitarie
notes.content:
Hey there Realmwalkers!

Since we launched into Early Access, we’ve had an amazing group of content creators join our Creator Program and start their adventures in the Faewilds. In our Creator Spotlights, we’ll be getting to know some of them a little bit better and let you know what they get up to when they’re not battling Bound in Nightingale. In this edition, we’ll be talking to Kiitarie about gung-ho companions, phobias and her passion for building elaborate estates.

Want to become part of the Nightingale Content Creator Program? Find out more [url=http://www.playnightingale.com/community]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/73789429d45e25a13445ce1665ccf95e8a10e21c.jpg[/img]

[b]What got you interested in becoming a gaming content creator?[/b]
I always wanted to meet new people and have awesome conversations. Content creation checks that box!

[b]How did you become part of the Nightingale community?[/b]
I was approached by Inflexion to be part of a small group of content creators to help give feedback on the game. It was such an amazing ride and experience.

[b]What’s your favourite type of content you like to create?[/b]
I love to BUILD. My YouTube is entirely related to building in all sorts of games. And my Twitch is almost always some sort of crafting survival adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/bf189d4f03ec3c9a6e60e271fa354cff9442e076.png[/img]

[b]What’s the greatest part of being a creator?[/b]
It all comes back to the reason why I started: meeting new people and having awesome conversations.

[b]Tell us a memorable moment from your time in the Faewilds.[/b]
Yelling at Edna (my recruit). It definitely became a thing for my channel. Once she decided to just stab a giant in the toe while I was talking to them…Chaos ensued.

[b]What would you say if you had to summarize what you love about Nightingale to someone who has never played it before?[/b]
Nightingale is an open-world crafting survival game, which you will absolutely adore if you are a fan of the genre. TBH if you are a fan of fae anything you should just give it a go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/0c2f963f6768a6276c03c00abf74988486b000e5.jpg[/img]

[b]What are you most looking forward to in the future of Nightingale?[/b]
I am looking forward to more of EVERYTHING!! More vaults, more biomes, more fae, MORE BUILDING!

[b]What do you do when you’re not creating content?[/b]
Sleep. Drawing tiny pictures for people (emotes). Anything to keep my hands busy and my mind quiet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/2e51f1eee2e9690868c78cc7436da302e44626df.jpg[/img]

[b]Tell us something you’re proud of since you started making content for your channels.[/b]
Finally taking that step into YouTube content and getting YouTube partner in just 7(ish) months.

[b]If you could add one feature to Nightingale in the future what would it be?[/b]
Creative Mode. I would be able to create way more Nightingale content with a creative mode. Plantable trees and bushes would be great too.

[b]Finally, tell us a random fact about yourself.[/b]
I used to be afraid of spiders. So much so, that I left Australia and moved to America to get away from them (just Kidding, I moved to be with my husband).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/1e485d9e4c5943f07f3ed8798ad3d99271571ee7.jpg[/img]

That’s it for today’s Creator Spotlight. Thanks to Kiitarie for taking the time to chat with us and sorry about all the Faewild spiders. Check out and follow Kiitarie on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/kiitarie]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@kiitarie]YouTube[/url].

Don’t forget to stay up to date with the latest news from Nightingale by following us on socials, and come back here soon for another Creator Spotlight.

notes.title: 0.2 Changelog
notes.content:
Realmwalkers,

Our server maintenance has concluded and our servers are now back online.

Please update your game to access the Realms once again. It's recommended to restart Steam/Epic or verify your game files to make sure you're on the latest version. The game version will also now appear in the main menu when you start the game.

[h1]0.2 Changelog[/h1]

✨ = Community requests

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] ✨Queued crafting
[*] ✨Craft from storage
[*] ✨UI improvements
[*] Three new weapons were added and various existing weapon/tool changes
[*] Universal dodge added
[*] Two new Bound types and changes to existing Lanternhead and Bombardier Bound
[*] New NPCs, as well as updated and new quests
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Adjustments to resource, clothing and weapon attributes -  now any attribute can be added to any item in crafting
[*] The ability to purchase Essence Trader wares from the Guidebook after discovering them
[/list]
[h2]Game Changes[/h2]
[h3]Art/Visual[/h3]
[list]
[*] General animation improvements to creatures, player characters, weapons, and tools
[*] Updated art for Tomatoes, Carrots, Wheat, Oats, Onions, and Potatoes. Yummy!
[*] Audio/SFX
[*] Nellie Bly is now a fully-voiced character
[*] Pain emote sound effect tweaked
[*] Adjusted combat music triggers to increase responsiveness
[/list]
[h3]Building[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tweaked building costs to make erecting large structures cheaper, and therefore quicker to construct
[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] New weapons have been added to the early game:
[list]
[*] Blunderbuss  - a two-handed shotgun that deals ranged area damage 
[*] Sheath of Throwing Knives - a ranged, projectile weapon that can be held in your offhand alongside other one-handed weapons
[*] Grenade Satchel - an explosive projectile that can be used in your offhand alongside other weapons[/list]
[*] Universal dodge added. This has made some changes to default keybinds (‘CTRL’ = Dodge, ‘C’ = Crouch,‘V’ = Crafting Menu. These can be changed in settings)
[*] New Boomerang Special Attack for Sickles
[*] New Parry Special Attack for Hunting Knife
[*] New Flurry Special Attack for Hammers
[/list]
[h3]Crafting[/h3]
[list]
[*] ✨Added craft from storage
[*] ✨Added crafting queue to all crafting stations
[*] Crafting weapons and tools with unique resources (resources with attributes attached) will now mean that the weapon or tool will inherit those attributes
[/list]
[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Bound have been added to the Realms:
[list][*] Aegis - a large Bound that carries two shields
[*] Breaker -  a slow-moving unit carrying the burden of its weapon on its back[/list]
[*] Bound Grenadier grenades are now explosive and no longer generate miasma. Additionally, their grenades now have a short fuse instead of exploding immediately on impact
[*] Bound Lanternheads now hang back and fire ranged attacks at Realmwalkers
[*] Low-level Bound wearing masks or helmets now do more damage
[*] Bound minions overall have had their health reduced
[*] Creature taunts now cancel if the creature is hit
[/list]
[h3]NPCs/Quests[/h3]
[list]
[*] Basic NPC companion commands added. Players can now toggle whether they want their companions to do things such as fight, heal, harvest, and more (most importantly, you can stop them from burning your precious wood). Keep in mind that you'll still have to manually equip the correct tools and give them the correct permissions (such as allowing them to access your chests) for their respective behaviours to function. They also don't need to be your current companion to exhibit these behaviours. We'll be continuing to improve and expand survivor behaviours in the future!
[*] New quest NPCs can be found in the Realms: Véronique Albertine Bianchi and Desma Valavani
[*] Aurelio’s quests have had minor changes to flow and rewards. Players who have already started the questline will continue to progress through the previous version
[*] Players who completed Nellie's Gateway to the Watch quest through the aggressive path are now able to go back and finish Frankenstein's, Ludivine's, and Danu's questlines with new dialogue
[*] Bound Dark Weavers have been reworked - players will need to clear tethered Bound before attacking their master
[*] Bound Casters now float closer to the ground and their teleport move has been tweaked and refined
[*] Various combat improvements for Bound Elite Minions and Bound Minions
[*] Re-enabled creature fall damage
[/list]
[h3]Resources[/h3]
[list]

notes.title: Compensation for Lost Progression
notes.content:
Heya Realmwalkers,

Over the March 9th weekend, some players lost their Realm progress due to an unintended bug in the system.

While we haven’t seen any new reports of this error since our emergency patch on March 10 - and we were able to rollback various player Realms - we understand that many folks lost progression during these windows.

To assist with rebuilding we added the ability to grant Essence Bundles to player accounts in the 0.1.2 update. Today we have granted a bundle to the following affected players:
[list]
[*] Everyone who submitted a Realm rollback request
[*] Accounts that our team flagged from the server side as losing a significant amount of data over the March 9 weekend
[/list]
If you were affected by, or suspect that you were affected by, the events of the March 9 weekend:
[list]
[*] Load into the character of your choice (this character must complete the tutorial Realms and talk to Puck in the Abeyance Realm to access the rewards)
[*] Open the menu using Esc
[*] Navigate to ‘System’ in the top menu
[*] Click on ‘Rewards’
[*] Redeem your bundle
[/list]
This bundle can only be redeemed on one character per affected user and contains the following:
[list]
[*] 500 T1 Essence
[*] 500 T2 Essence
[*] 1500 T3 Essence
[/list]
If you were affected by these events but were not granted the bundle, please submit a support ticket by visiting our player support portal (https://inflexiongames.zendesk.com/hc/en-us) and clicking ‘Submit a request’.

If you were blocked from progressing due to falling in The Watch, please also feel free to submit a ticket using the player support portal link and instructions above.

Thank you all again as we continue this journey together,

- The Nightingale Team

notes.title: Update Regarding Players Losing Respite Realms | March 11, 2024
notes.content:
Realmwalkers, 

Over the last few days we’ve had a few reports of progression blockers we’d like to provide updates on.

[h3]Incident Recap[/h3]
[list]
[*] March 5th: We started getting reports that some players were falling through world maps, most of these reports were from The Watch.
[*] March 8th: We pushed a backend update to the servers that would detect if players were in this falling state when loading back in, and if they were deemed to be under the map, the game would force them back into their Respite Abeyance Realm. 
[*] March 9th: Approximately at 3:00 am MT we started getting reports that some players’ Realms seemed like they were being reset. Out of an abundance of caution, we removed the server change from the day before. After further investigation, it was deemed that the server change was not a direct cause of this issue, but as higher volumes of people were getting funneled back to their Respite, it meant more people were encountering the problem.  We attempted a server change and started Respite Realm rollback requests, but we later discovered the server change was not enough to solve the issue so additional hotfixes were investigated.
[*] March 10th: We pushed a game update so servers would do additional data checks before players enter a Realm. If there was a larger data discrepancy than expected, would abort loading and disconnect. If this happens, players should try to load in again. This prevented save data from being automatically overwritten in an incomplete state, but it meant that players were more likely to encounter Travel Errors. 
[/list]
[h3]Current Status[/h3]
[list]
[*] Since the emergency patch on March 10th, we have not seen any confirmed reports of players experiencing a Realm reset with valid save files after the update.
[*] We are continuing to track down the root issue so that we can fully address these cases that now result in a Travel Error.
[*] We have applied rollbacks to all those who asked for one up to 4:00pm MT on March 11.
[*] The issues of some players falling at The Watch are outstanding. We will be re-applying the March 8th server change as soon as possible as the new data checks are in place.
[*] Additional concerns or reports, such as, but not limited to, invisible walls and inconsistent build limits, are still a WIP as these are separate considerations.
[/list]
Please note that if you have not logged in since 4:00pm MT on March 10th, please check if your Realm was affected before the patch.

[strike]If you have logged in as of 6:00pm MT on March 11 and your Respite Realm has been reset or a rollback request failed, please submit (or re-submit) the following form: [url=https://forms.gle/RsDFmr2HkSH1MxWP8]https://forms.gle/RsDFmr2HkSH1MxWP8[/url]

Please include the following details in the notes:
[list]
[*] When was the last time your Respite Realm was in a good state (not reset)?
[*] Have you previously submitted a reset request?
[*] Did you have more than one Abeyance Realm?
[/list]
If you share a Respite Realm with others, only one submission from your group is needed.

Once you have placed a reset request, please do not log into the character until we share the next rollback wave has been completed on our social channels (listed [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1928980/discussions/1/7221029098491784414/]here[/url]).[/strike]

[i][March 20 Edit: Rollback requests are now closed.][/i]

We continue to investigate additional long-term fixes and additional updates. 

Thank you for your patience and apologize again to all those affected.

- The Nightingale Team (Inflexion Games)

notes.title: Nightingale CEO "not satisfied" with launch as player count plummets
notes.content:
Nightingale is one of the prettiest survival games I've seen, yet its launch via Steam Early Access has been met with a rather tepid response from players. Released just over two weeks ago on Tuesday February 20, the Nightingale player count has fallen to just over one fifth of its launch peak, while Steam reviews sit at a 'mixed' 61%. Inflexion Games CEO Aaryn Flynn says he is "not satisfied" with parts of the launch, saying, "there's much more to do."

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Development Priorities and Message from CEO
notes.content:
Hello, Realmwalkers!

Let me begin by saying a heartfelt thank you to all of you for your patience and support since our Nightingale Early Access launch a couple of weeks ago. We’ve learned a ton in such a short time, which helped us prioritize work immediately after launch and beyond. Your commitment, feedback, and passion are the fuel the dev team runs on.

While we’re happy with some elements of our launch, we’re not satisfied with a number of others. These include network issues, confusing or missing features for core systems like crafting, and important updates to combat. With yesterday’s patch, we started addressing many of the most urgent gaps and bugs in the overall game experience. But there’s much more to do, and we wanted to share our next round of most important updates with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/72540f04c6ceca78badd7ba526e7fef7b4b8e1f1.jpg[/img]

Rest assured the team has been working very hard on these areas and more, and we look forward to sharing specifics on these updates with you soon. Until then, happy adventuring in the Faewilds!

- Aaryn Flynn, CEO, Inflexion Games

notes.title: Nightingale - Launch Week Highlights
notes.content:
Greetings Realmwalkers,

We finally opened the Realms this past week and we’ve been overwhelmed by the intrepidness and creativity of all the fledgling Realmwalkers exploring Nightingale for the first time. We’ve been receiving the feedback, watching the streams, and reading through your tales of Realm-diving adventures over the last few days. A heartfelt thank you from everyone here at Inflexion. 

To wrap up our first week of Early Access, we wanted to provide an update on some of the work we’re doing here at the studio, as well as spotlight some of the cool community content we’ve been enjoying. 

[h2]NEXT STEPS[/h2]
As you may have seen us discuss recently, we have several big and small updates that we’re working on right now. The most significant of which is the implementation of an offline mode - you can read more about that here:
[url=https://playnightingale.com/news/offline-play] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/431e9aea861e22888f132b0cee975a5eb3f28e95.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Known Issues Under Investigation
notes.content:
We already released one patch this week and are working on a more substantial update to resolve several issues and bugs that we’ve been tracking. 

As we continue to squash those pesky bugs internally, we’ve compiled several troubleshooting articles to help Realmwalkers navigate the more notable issues:

[h2]Crashes:[/h2]
These are being caused by a couple of hardware and software issues. A number of these can be solved with software updates for Windows and your graphics card or by verifying your game files. If you’re experiencing crashes, please search for the error message on our tech support knowledge base (linked below), and if you continue to experience them, please send us a support ticket:
https://inflexiongames.zendesk.com/hc/en-us


[h2]Players not matchmaking into the closest region:[/h2]
Our servers auto-matchmake users to the region with the lowest ping for them at the time of spinning up a Realm for the first time. For some reason, whether it’s ISPs, VPNs, or otherwise, some users were placed into a much further region than they would expect, even if later on their closest server had better ping. 

We are tackling this in two ways:

We are opening up South American and Oceania servers this weekend. Keep an eye out on our socials for when they’re live. Please note if your Realm was already placed in a different server, you will need to start a new one to be put into these new server regions.

In the next patch, players will see what region our server recommends based on ping when in the character creator. You will be able to override this and force it to place you in the region of your choice. Please note these settings will not apply if you visit a friend’s Realm in a different region, or in The Watch.

[h2]Network Errors:[/h2]
These can present themselves in a few ways, but if you’re experiencing these, please check out this article for troubleshooting tips and if they don’t solve the problem, please send a support ticket for further assistance: https://inflexiongames.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/22958338069147--A-network-error-has-occurred-message


[h2]Swamp Portal not loading: [/h2]
For some players after defeating the Bound in the Swamp tutorial Realm, the portal does not open. Our team is investigating why this is happening and will be adding more logging into the new patch to try to track down this elusive issue.
If this happens to you, please check the following article and submit a ticket so we can continue to document this error:
https://inflexiongames.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/23116577864987-Swamp-Tutorial-Portal-Doesn-t-Open


[h2]Dying or disconnecting in tutorial Realms:[/h2]
This can cause the player character to be in a bad state (crashing, network errors, etc.). This seems to be related to the issue above, so we’re hoping the extra log information will help track this down. For now, if this happens to you, please submit your player logs in a ticket here so we can track how many users this is affecting and provide you with updates as they become available: https://inflexiongames.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/22779159531547-How-do-I-get-my-player-logs


[h2]Hotbar All Shovel Icons: [/h2]
This is a visual bug and doesn’t actually replace your items with shovels thankfully. Mouse over the items to reveal the true items. Our team is working on a fix and will provide an update when it’s patched.


[h2]Infinite Essence exploit:[/h2]
Savvy users have discovered that you can buy water for less Essence than you sell it back for. This will be fixed in the next patch.


[h2]Default Graphics Settings Being Set to Ultra:[/h2]

notes.title: Nightingale - A Message on Offline Play
notes.content:
[i][UPDATE: To address questions we've received, development on other updates (QoL, new content, fixes, bugs and other work) continues uninterrupted and we'll have more news on those to share in the coming days][/i]

Hey Realmwalkers,

We’ve seen a lot of discussion in recent days around our decision to make Nightingale online-only at our Early Access release. We understand that this can be frustrating for a number of reasons.

Our vision for the game since inception was to create an interconnected series of Realms, with the idea of allowing for co-operative exploration in mind - a universe bigger than a single Realm or server. That meant we made a choice early in development between supporting co-op from day one or focusing development on an offline mode.

Co-operative gameplay associated with having party members across multiple Realms was the more technically challenging problem and therefore the one we chose to tackle first. Looking back on that decision, we misjudged what some of you were looking for in your experience.

We are now prioritizing and developing an offline mode that we plan to release as soon as feasible. Keep an eye on our social channels and Discord for updates in the coming weeks alongside other things we're working on. Thank you to everyone who has stepped into the Realms with us so far - the journey has just begun and we look forward to sharing it with you all.

- The Inflexion Team

notes.title: Stunning new survival game struggles to escape Palworld's orbit
notes.content:
Last week, I got a chance to play Nightingale, a new survival-crafting game with a heavy Victorian Gaslamp aesthetic and more than a few mythic curios. It comes from Inflexion Games, which includes some former Bioware staff who worked on Mass Effect and Dragon Age. The basic loop will be familiar to anyone who has brushed against the genre in recent years; build a base, craft tools, and explore. Where Nightingale aims to stand apart, though, is that this busywork is surrounded by a world full of wonder and a story that, quite literally, goes places.

Nightingale's aesthetic grabs me from the word go; thick wool suits, dandy umbrellas, and heaving mustaches. It's a perfect look for the 'frontier' type of exploration the survival game promises. Throw in a story about Fae creatures revealing themselves and changing the course of history itself and I'm sold. The Fae introduced magick (spelled with a 'k' so you know it's serious) to humans and spurred on an unprecedented era of technological advancement.

notes.title: Nightingale Server Stress Test Details
notes.content:
Feb 1, 2024 EDIT: Slight change to the Server Stress Test procedures!

We will now be allowing everyone to download and play at the same time, instead of in waves!

What this means for you:
[list]
[*] We will accept everyone who signed up for the test at 10:00 am MT tomorrow
[*] The servers will be also open at 10:00 am MT, so you can jump in as soon as you’re done downloading
[*] The test will still go until 2:00 pm MT
[/list]

If you or your friends haven't signed up for the test yet, you still have time to do so, and even if you forget, you will be able to register even after the test begins as long as servers are open.

See you then!

[EDIT END]

---

As we continue to travel toward Realms unknown, we’re ready to reveal additional details on an upcoming Nightingale milestone, the Server Stress Test!

[h3]When is the stress test?[/h3]

Players will start receiving access to download the game at 10:00 am MT on February 2, 2024. Servers will open access to the Realms starting at 11:00 am MT and will close at 2:00 pm Mountain Time.

[h3]How will it work?[/h3]

At 10:00 am MT, we will start granting access to people who signed up on Steam in waves. These players will be selected randomly by Steam’s system.

We will monitor how many people have downloaded the game and will grant access to more batches throughout the test based on various test factors (how many people are active, how servers are faring, etc.).

We recommend that folks download the game as soon as they’re given access, but players granted access before the server live time will not be able to load into a Realm until the servers start at 11:00 am MT. Those granted access after this start time will be able to join the game as soon as their game has finished downloading.

Our goal is for all players who signed up for the test to be able to participate. How quickly that happens will be dependent on how the test progresses.

[h3]What will I play during the test?[/h3]

Players will enter a tailored version of Nightingale’s early game experience that skips tutorial content and has each Realmwalker equipped with upgraded tools and gear, as well as a variety of recipes unlocked (this will be the equivalent to what a Realmwalker can earn approximately 10 hours into a typical playthrough). Players will be able to immediately join and play together with friends in the Realms. 

This will be a different experience than what players will encounter when they first enter the Realms on February 22, but we wanted the stress test to offer a few more tools and resources at an earlier stage in the journey to give players more of a taste of what’s to come ahead of our launch later in the month.

No hard limits have been placed on the build so anyone in the Realms can play as long as the servers are online and functional. 

We’ll be sharing some gameplay tips and things to look out for, closer to when the test begins.

[h3]How will I know I was selected?[/h3]

Participants will receive an email from Steam, but the quickest way to check is to refresh the Nightingale Steam page periodically after 10:00 am MT on February 2, 2024.

[h3]Why are you granting access in waves?[/h3]

There are two things the team wants to assess during the playtest: 

How we handle large amounts of players logging in at the same time
Our ability to rapidly scale up access if there is an influx of players

Doing this in waves means we can test both.

A way to think about it is that instead of turning on a tap at 100% the first time, we’ll be turning it on at 50%, checking for leaks, and all looking well, we’ll see if it handles at full capacity. This way we can check for various bottlenecks throughout the test.

[h3]What if something goes wrong during the test?[/h3]

It is possible that something may go awry during the stress test - and that’s all part of the reason why we’re doing it! 

We’ll be posting regular updates on our [url=https://discord.gg/playnightingale ]Official Discord server[/url]. If there are any issues with Discord during the test, here are our backup social channels to check:
X/Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/PlayNightingale]playnightingale[/url]
Threads: [url=https://www.threads.net/@playnightingale?hl=en]playnightingale[/url]
Bluesky: [url=https://bsky.app/profile/playnightingale.bsky.social]playnightingale[/url]

We’ll be opening a Discord forum channel for test feedback, as well as providing a form on Discord for major technical issues shortly before the test is live.

If there are delays in the servers going online, performance issues, or complete server failure, players will be unable to access the Realms, or may experience Travel Errors and Network Errors. This can prevent people from entering a Realm or playing the game at all depending on the scope of the issue. 

Whatever happens, it will be valuable data for the team to ensure we’re ready for Early Access launch.

[h3]Will my save data/character from the stress test transfer to the launch version?[/h3]

Unfortunately not. We have critical updates and patches planned for the launch version that aren’t in the parked stress test version and these changes may cause stability issues.

[h3]How do I sign up?[/h3]

Head over to our Steam page and click on “Request Access” before February 2 for the best chance at participating.

[h3]What if I sign up after the test starts?[/h3]

We may grant access to people up to half an hour before the test ends, but it will depend on team availability and the volume of requests. Our goal is to get everyone into the Realms as long as we have the test running, and we don’t experience any technical difficulties.

[h3]Can I stream or capture video/screenshots from the stress test?[/h3]

This test is not under NDA and if you choose to make content about the game based on this test, please ensure that it is explicitly obvious that the footage and impressions are based on the server stress test version and experience.

For those who played in previous playtests, information such as your previous playtesting impressions, non-public game knowledge, or any captured footage (screenshots/video) from those playtests remains prohibited.

[h3]Does this test mean that the launch will work smooth like butter?[/h3]

We wish that we could say with 100% certainty that this was the case, but as we’ve learned from many experiences, nothing is guaranteed. Our team remains very committed to delivering a great first time experience and solving any issues quickly and effectively. We are grateful for your support and understanding in this process! Whatever happens at launch, this test gives our team a chance to remove as many potential issues before that date.

—

As always, we extend our sincerest gratitude to every one of you who join this expedition with us. We’ll see you on February 2, but until then, we’ll accept all crossed fingers, toes, and good vibes to send toward the servers and the team members who wrangle them.

The Nightingale Team
(Inflexion Games)

notes.title: Nightingale Multiplayer Overview
notes.content:
The Faewilds are ready for any intrepid adventurer hardy enough to explore its distant mysteries and take on its many challenges. But, sometimes, it’s more fun to go on the adventure with a friend or two. Whether you’re looking to transform a cosy estate into a sprawling village together, or team up for a formidable Apex creature hunt, there’s no limit to what you can achieve as a team in Nightingale. 

Here’s a quick guide on how Nightingale’s multiplayer will work at Early Access launch.

[h2]ALONE IN THE REALMS?[/h2]
In Nightingale, you have the choice to venture forth alone or within a group of up to 6 players. Nightingale is a PvE survival crafting game with no PvP or friendly fire within the Realms at Early Access launch. By default, you will not encounter other players in your Realm unless you’re in a co-op party or set your Realm to ‘Public’.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/957e898a84eee25b05c9ec91870dcac186acccaa.jpg[/img]
[h3]Public Realms[/h3]
A ‘Public’ Realm allows players to see everyone else occupying that specific Realm on their map. Anyone who joins these Public Realms can complete encounters independently and interact with structures that other players have built. This means that anyone can help build (...or destroy) other players’ estates. You can even choose to party up with any players you encounter.

You’ll be given the option to open a ‘Public’ Realm for any realm you visit after your Abeyance (starting or home) Realm. From here, each portal archway you find or build has a Realm Card machine (where you can insert your desired combination of Realm Cards to open a portal to a new destination). It’s in the portal machine interface that you will find the option to make a Realm ‘Public’.

[h2]PARTY MECHANICS[/h2]
Playing together with friends in a party is available within any Realm (‘Public’ or otherwise) outside of the opening tutorial. All players who wish to party up while playing Nightingale will first need to complete the opening tutorial segments within the Byway Realms before party invites can be sent or received. Once the tutorial is completed and you’ve arrived in your introductory Abeyance Realm, the ability to join and send party invites becomes available. At this point, you’ll be able to join friends either in their Realm or invite them to join you in yours, as well as start in-game voice chat with the people in your party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/7d9472b701b5f1ea65c5282a69728808fcb33534.jpg[/img]
Whether you have friends who are seasoned Realmwalkers or friends who are new to the game, that’s okay too. There are no restrictions in terms of the level of player you can group up with when playing cooperatively - just keep in mind that lower-level players may need a bit more assistance during difficult encounters!

Once you’re in a party and sharing a Realm with other players, then you can begin your adventure together. Here are a few things you can expect:

[h3]Establishing Your Home[/h3]
If you and your party dream of sharing a Realm to call home, then there are a couple of things you’ll need to do. Players can set their ‘Respite Realm’ (aka home Realm) by placing down an ‘Estate Cairn’ (this acts as a beacon transmitting through the multi-Realmic void, always guiding you back to your estate). Each player can set one ‘Respite Realm’ at a time, so if you all want to live in the same Realm, then you’ll each need to place your cairns in that specific Realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/129d118d7ce9a6dcf7694a722ba1929907863b6f.jpg[/img]
Similarly, anyone who sets a location as their ‘Respite Realm’ can return to that Realm and play, regardless of whether or not their other party members are online. This way groups can play asynchronously without needing a third-party hosting platform!

[h3]To Share or Not To Share[/h3]
When traveling with your friends, loot chests from completing encounters are instanced per player (unlike loot you find or gain elsewhere in the Realms). Also, if you want to trade or give items to your party members, you can do that by dropping the item you want to share. Sharing is caring!

[h3]Adventuring with Friends[/h3]
Quests, on the other hand, are tracked per player. Each player will need to complete the various quest steps to progress further. However, in the majority of cases, players are always able to join friends to help each other out and are not restricted by individual completion levels. When it comes to encounters like fighting an Apex creature: if the encounter is completed with everyone in the group participating in the encounter, everyone will reap the benefits/get the same completion rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/9ce3c90b6bfc3e69b39b0aa474375bfce7a9f262.jpg[/img]
We wish you the best of luck as you traverse the Faewilds of Nightingale, whether you choose to do it alone or with a choice coterie of fellow Realmwalkers. We look forward to seeing you when the portals to Early Access open on 22nd February, 2024.

notes.title: Server Stress Test Announcement
notes.content:
In preparation for our upcoming Early Access launch, we’re inviting all aspiring Realmwalkers to help us “break the portal network” as we stress-test the Nightingale servers in early 2024. We welcome everyone to sign up for the event as it will give players eagerly anticipating the release of Nightingale a taste of the Realms before they officially open on February 22, 2024.

[h2]How to Participate:[/h2]

To sign up for the playtest, all you need to do is click the “Request Access” button on our Steam page under the “Nightingale Playtest” section: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1928980/]Steam page.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/f7e4fd56448a968bceb02f8d9b4bda4579b1a45a.png[/img]

This stress test is completely separate from any previous playtesting you may have been a part of. If you previously completed a playtesting survey or received playtesting keys, they WILL NOT grant you access to the stress test. You must sign up for the playtest on our Steam page to ensure you’re eligible.

You do not need to buy a copy of the game to participate in the stress test - participation is completely free for you!

[h2]Key Dates and Times:[/h2]

In January, we'll be going into more detail about the stress test, including final information on the date and times, as well as confirming the maximum number of participants. Be sure to keep an eye out for emails, our socials, and/or Discord for more information as it becomes available.

[h2]What to Expect:[/h2]

There are no bad outcomes to this test. Whether it’s all smooth connections, or the servers catch fire, the team will gain valuable information to prepare for the Early Access launch in February.  

We hope that all participants can connect to the Realms and enjoy the first couple of hours of the game without interruption. However, it may be that all or some participants might experience longer than usual connection times, or may not be able to connect at all. Whatever happens, we’ll be with you the whole way, communicating through the Official Discord [[url=https://discord.gg/playnightingale]join here[/url]].

[h2]Wrap Up:[/h2]

Don't miss out on the chance to be a part of Nightingale's journey from development to launch! Sign up for the stress test on our Steam page, and get ready to immerse yourself in a world of magick and adventure. We can't wait to see you, and together, let's make Nightingale an unforgettable experience for all Realmwalkers!

notes.title: Nightingale system requirements
notes.content:
What are the Nightingale system requirements? You won't require the efforts of a pixel-pushing GPU before you can get to becoming a highly skilled Realmwalker in Nightingale. You can take on the PVE open-world survival crafting game alone, or with friends, using even the most basic of rigs.

However, Inflexion Games does require that you'll need a chonky amount of storage space before you can start adventuring through transdimensional portals in Nightingale, so perhaps one of the best gaming SSDs should be on your shopping list.

notes.title: Gamescom Trailer & February Launch Date
notes.content:
For those of you who caught our gamescom trailer at Opening Night Live, you may have noticed an important announcement at the end.

If you haven't seen it yet, you can find it [url=https://youtu.be/1dcRqDhVVV8]here[/url].

[previewyoutube=1dcRqDhVVV8;full][/previewyoutube]
We'll go into some of the trailer details later in this blog post, but for now, let's talk about the Early Access release date.

[h1]Nightingale is Launching into Early Access on February 22, 2024[/h1]
[i]"After years of dedicated work from the team, we are thrilled to announce that Nightingale will enter Early Access on February 22nd, 2024. That date is a few months later than we previously announced. But as a studio, we’re committed to quality, and we take player satisfaction very seriously. We want to ensure that the game delivers on the expectations of our community, who have played a vital role in the development to date. We strive to ensure that Nightingale not only fulfills our vision but also becomes a cherished place for our players to explore and discover with their friends for many years to come,"[/i] [b]says Aaryn Flynn, CEO of Inflexion Games[/b]

While we hope you share our excitement about our confirmed Early Access release date, we understand that some of you may also be wondering why the shift from Fall 2023. 

This new release date provides us with additional time to test and make the right choices to deliver the experience that we know our players expect and deserve. We are going to take the extra time to prioritize refining gameplay, minimizing bugs, and ensuring that our Early Access fulfills the promise of what Nightingale can be. So, to answer some questions you probably have:

[b]Q. Will Nightingale still be launching into Early Access?[/b]
A. It sure will! We're treating Early Access launch very seriously - ensuring that it has substance and delivers on player expectations. Early Access gives players a chance to participate in development - something that we've already begun with our playtests - and it gives the team a unique opportunity to explore new ideas with a live community. We'll be regularly iterating and improving the game throughout Early Access, adding new content along the way. We want to make sure we give it the best start possible.

[b]Q. How much is Nightingale going to be?[/b]
A. It is currently planned to launch at $29.99 USD (other territories to come). 

[b]Q. Does this mean Nightingale will launch with no bugs? [/b]
A. We can't promise a zero-bugs launch, but we are working hard to make sure that our Early Access release is smooth and, above all else, fun to play.

[b]Q. Can we expect a lot more content with the additional time?[/b]
A. While we have some more content we haven't talked about publicly, we're focused on polishing what we have now. That may mean some small quality-of-life additions, but we're not expecting to add significant scope to the game at this time. 

[b]Q. Did upgrading to 5.2 impact the launch date?[/b]
A. While this did take some developer hours, this launch date would have happened even if we had stayed in 5.1.

[b]Q. Will there be more playtests?[/b]
A. We're still discussing this internally, but likely it will come down to the results of our upcoming playtest (of which, invites have already been sent). The best place to keep informed about any potential future playtests is our Discord: https://discord.gg/playnightingale.


[b]Q. I still have lots of questions about the game and want to see more, you're not going to go radio silent, are you?[/b]
A. That's not in the plan, no! In fact, we're currently writing our next Developer Update, working on short-form video content and discussing other ways to show you all what we're working on. If there's something you want to see more of, kindly let us know via our various social platforms!

[h1]New Stuff from the Trailer[/h1]
[b]Swimming[/b]
This was the first trailer that shows off that your Realmwalker does, in fact, know how to swim! Be careful though, as swimming can be exhausting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/53827e15387c6222db03284d85431fb743a94a5e.jpg[/img]
[b]Fae Tower[/b]
A mysterious place teaming with Bound? Get a glimpse at what awaits you in Fae Towers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/82d84143ac43803b5a181a7d99105e0231a968f0.jpg[/img]
[b]New Clothing Items[/b]
We've added some more clothing items! All of the outfits in the trailer can be unlocked and crafted in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/e6673549c76e4e74792787d379c52e3ef618f35f.jpg[/img]
[b]Bhutan Building Set[/b]
Those with keen eyes will have spotted a new Estate style. We're going to showcase it more in the coming months, so make sure to follow our social channels for additional builds using this building set.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/68e915e64639ea3313fec632cc2e9e1b4dae3036.jpg[/img]
[b]Sun Giant[/b]
These creatures are generally curious and intrigued by gifts from Realmwalkers, but if you decide to take one of them on, be ready for a tough fight. They can use their magick to turn the sands against you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/838d6f05463e6678c5c91ff361715801c1bb4201.jpg[/img]
[b]Automaton Knight[/b]
A new addition to the Automata line, unlike many of its kin, it is a fierce aggressor who will actively defend other Automatons. Armed with a vicious beam of energy - part magick and part electricity - even the most intrepid Explorer steers clear lest they be reduced to smoldering ash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/4fbe47d4c18aa4ca8707ed853cbeef82aa54afda.jpg[/img]
[b]New Enchantments[/b]
We've been adding some more enchantments behind the scenes, and you can catch a glimpse of a few of them in the trailer. From fire and lightning ammo to Rescission and Realmic Preservation magick, we're excited to share what we've been doing in future community updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/b4d7b96b131b3818d67a93f17917df781d51525d.jpg[/img]
-

Phew! You made it to the end!! To everyone who continues to share their support and understanding throughout this journey with us, we appreciate you so much. We cannot do this without you.

Much love,

- The Nightingale Team at Inflexion Games

notes.title: Playtest Update: Surveys
notes.content:
Hey Realmwalkers,

Today we have an update about Closed Alpha playtesting. Over the next few days we'll be sending out a survey, which you’ll need to complete for a chance to participate. Everyone who has signed up for our newsletter on [url=https://www.playnightingale.com/]our website[/url] will receive an email containing the survey. Sign-ups will remain open throughout the testing period.

Closed Alpha is our first phase of testing. Participants will gain access to an early, in-development experience to test specific aspects of gameplay, rather than the entire game. Future tests will expand the gameplay and player numbers. 

Please read the details below for more information.

[b]How do I apply for tests?[/b]
We’ll be sending out a survey via email to those who signed up for the newsletter. You can still sign up on  [url=https://www.playnightingale.com/]our website[/url]. Keep an eye on your inbox and make sure our emails aren’t going to spam (you may want to add contact@playnightingale.com to your whitelist). 

[b]When will playtests take place?[/b]
We’re coming up to our first planned playtest. If you’re successfully chosen to participate we will send you date and timing details. 

[b]How many people will be selected to test?[/b]
We will be starting with a small number of people and expanding over time.

[b]How will you be selecting who gets into tests?[/b]
There will be several factors including but not limited to: when you signed up for the newsletter, your survey answers, your system specs, game genre preferences, and community involvement.

[b]Can I stream/take screenshots/make content about the playtest, or discuss it online?[/b]
Not at this time. As these tests do not represent the final Nightingale experience, there will be a strict NDA in place.

[b]What if I don’t get selected for these tests?[/b]
We’re planning more playtests leading up to launch, so please keep an eye out for future communications. You will not need to reapply for future tests.

Thanks for your support! <3

notes.title: Inflexion's Reflections: September 2022
notes.content:
Nightingale development continues to keep everyone here at Inflexion Games busy. But as we get closer to our Early Access launch next year, we thought it was about time that we started sharing a little bit more about what’s going on here behind the scenes. 

In this edition of Inflexion Reflections, we’ll take a look at what a few members of the team have been working on, and share some work-in-progress images and footage of the game. 

Let’s start things off with a bang…


[b]THUNDERSTORMS[/b]
Todd has been working on thunderstorms that will bring a bit of shock and awe to the various realms. "We wanted Nightingale's weather effects to feel as realistic as possible, so I spent a week studying slow-motion videos of lightning storms to make sure I got the branching just right," Todd said. "Lightning is huge, but incredibly quick- on average, most strikes last less than a quarter of a second. To make up for that, the bolts are incredibly bright- they'll light up the terrain around you in a storm.

“As a storm comes in, you'll see cloud lightning off on the horizon, but as the storm approaches you'll start to see cloud-to-cloud discharges, and then when the storm gets really bad, you might even see the bolts hit the ground."

notes.title: Discord Q&A - July 2022
notes.content:
As the studio continues to buckle down on Nightingale’s development, we’ve been taking some time to answer some of the community questions over on the [url=https://discord.gg/playnightingale]Official Nightingale Discord™[/url], where there has been no shortage of activity since it launched. 

To kick-off the first Discord Q&A we picked 25 questions to answer, which were a blend of highly popular questions as well as other ones that we know we can comfortably answer at this point in time. It may be a case that some of these answers may change or be redundant as we go through development and testing of the game. But we’ll do our best to communicate those changes as they happen. 

Don’t forget: hop into the [url=https://discord.gg/playnightingale]Nightingale Discord[/url] if you want to participate in future Q&As! But, without further ado, here we go…

[b]Q: The most recent gameplay trailer shows a zeppelin near the end. What capabilities do you have planned for that vehicle? / Will there be air combat from the airship, and if so, what will it look like?
[/b]
[i]A: There will be airships in the game at Early Access launch, but not as player facing vehicles[/i]

[b]Q: Regarding buildings and constructible Furniture/items, do these recipes all serve a purpose or are there going to be a lot of cosmetic only recipes? This is a big problem in other games of the genre if you are a feature first kind of person. / Will furniture like beds and chairs be interactable to be able to physically sit/lie down on to reward players that choose to invest resources in decorative and world building elements, and if so, will the AI companions be found interacting with them?[/b]

[i]A: Buildings will provide respite from Bound attacks. As for the variety of building styles, right now the different styles are mostly cosmetic. As for furniture pieces, we're currently working out what functionalities we can implement in time for the early access launch.
[/i]
[b]Q: Will you be able to pick back up your build pieces after them being placed or is there like a timer?[/b]

[i]A: Currently player placed pieces can be destroyed by you or your party members after they are built. This destruction will give some of the resources back for reuse.[/i]

[b]Q: Can we edit existing structures or only build around them?[/b]

[i]A: Yes we are working on this functionality for Early Access.
[/i]
[b]Q: What can we expect from the crafting/building system? Are there any specific games you took inspiration from in developing it?[/b]

[i]A: We get inspiration from a lot of games in the genre (and complimentary genres)! Realmwalkers will be given some basic recipes for crafting and schematics for building when they start, and will be able to discover new schematics by collecting certain materials, talking to NPCs, or completing quests.
[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/31f897bc4f66b94a47b810078ebfd30e81f89e07.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: Will there be a recycle/dismantling system for items crafted in game?[/b]

[i]A: Currently you can dismantle build structures like crafting benches, walls, etc. You can also destroy and repair crafted tools.[/i]

[b]Q: Are there 'bosses' that can only be fought as a group or will it be possible to completely solo the game with enough preparation?
[/b]
[i]A: Our intention is that solo players will be able to play the entire game by themselves, but solo completionists will be in for a challenging experience. [/i]

[b]Q: What will base defense look like, if any?[/b]

[i]A: As it is now, players can set up barricades or structures to keep out Bound or other creature attacks. Players can then attack the Bound from a safe distance using ranged weapons. This is something that's constantly evolving and we'll be showing more of in the future.
[/i]
[b]Q: What percentage of people registered for the newsletter do you expect to allow into the beta?[/b]

[i]A: It's really hard to say right now especially since we haven't done our survey to get a better idea of computer specs yet.[/i]
[b]
Q: Unlikely, but: Any chance that invitations for playtest could include the option to invite a couple more people to co-op? As playing with friends is usually the most fun way of playing these kinds of games[/b]

[i]A: This is something we're considering as we prepare our playtesting surveys, so thanks for the reminder! We can't make any promises yet, but we'll see what's possible.
[/i]
[b]Q: What happens when only part of a group goes to a new realm? Or do all players have to stay in one realm at a time? If we all have to stay in one realm, what happens when 1 group leaves the respite realm and then someone tries to log in that is in the respite realm?[/b]

[i]A: Players can choose whether or not to join their friends in other realms, so you can absolutely be split between different realms! As for someone else logging in, they will need to be given a party invite, and they will be able to choose as to who in your party they'd like to be teleported to.[/i]

[b]Q: Will the world save data be hosted in the cloud such that any previous player can start the world when no one else is hosting? Or will the world save be tied to the original host and only be accessible via that player hosting?[/b]

[i]A: Yes, world save data is hosted in the cloud. The world save will be hosted by a specific player. Other players in your party will be able to continue playing if the host disconnects, but they won't be able to spin it up themselves.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/f0cc903a92b955ceca333f3bddfe9bdfffff963b.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: I know the details of Dedicated Servers is still being worked on, but is there any info you can supply regarding them? Player Cap? Server Specs?[/b]

[i]A: Right now we're looking at between 6-10 players in a realm. Much like PC specs, it's a little early for us to share other specific details, as we're still experimenting with a bunch of things.[/i]

[b]Q: Can players control access to the realm their estate is in, such that they can invite friends over and give them access to resources without leaving them out for just anyone to take?[/b]

[i]A: Players can invite people to visit their respite realm and kick people from their realm. We are investigating more specific access controls, but currently if you invite someone into your realm they have total access to everything within it.[/i]

[b]Q: Will characters be tied to specific games/ servers or will we be able to take them haunting around like in Terraria.[/b]

[i]A: Players can have multiple characters, and any one of those can join any other player realms once invited.[/i]

[b]Q: About 'Death' in general : how punishing are 'death' in game? 
For example, if you die, do you spawn back in saved spot (estate) and drop your inventory on the spot you died or do you lose partial or all of the inventory? or do you not lose any of your inventory but lose 'hope' bar instead? if you could grab the inventory that was dropped , would there be a timer to get back your inventory?[/b]

[i]A: Right now we have a fairly standard death system where players lose their full inventory on death and respawn at their respite spawn point. There are no timers to get your inventory back and there are death markers to show where it is. Any buffs you may have had pre-death, will also be removed (such as eating recently).[/i]

[b]Q: Will environmental resources respawn or will they be only available the one time after having been foraged (trees cut down/herbs or plants picked/rocks or ores mined, etc)? Will there be ways to replenish resources such as farming/planting if they do not respawn?[/b]

[i]A: Most resources don't respawn naturally. The main way to get additional resources is to venture into further realms.[/i]

[b]Q: What can I expect out of the Hunger System, a split for food and water, different types of foods providing certain buffs and nerfs to your character, Food for specific situations, and is there a way the hunger system will be unique from other survival crafting games?[/b]

[i]A: As it is right now, going hungry will give you certain debuffs but will not kill you. As for other systems, we're experimenting with a few options and will detail them once we've made a decision.[/i]

[b]Q: What will end game look like?[/b]

[i]A: It is our ambition that there will always be something to do in the game. New realms to explore, new structures to build, new gear to craft - all in the spirit of "Endless Adventures". We'll have more to say about specifics later![/i]

[b]Q: As a Dev, what was the trickiest part about designing Nightingale?[/b]

[i]A: We have so many cools ideas but picking which ones to prioritize is tough. They always take so much more time to make than to think up! We're very excited about the universe and want to do so much, so questions and thoughts from the community are really valuable to help us prioritize and plan.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/6e23133310c27cd3fdffa1984cede9b88cec6945.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: How much and what kind of narrative are you going to build into the game? / I'm a lore lover... Will this game have a deep lore?[/b]

[i]A: Nightingale is a gaslamp fantasy universe. So expect some mysticism and a darker tale of survival. Some of the narrative will be told through the environments, some of it through codex entries, and some of it will be through NPCs. We'll show this off more clearly closer to the launch. Our narrative team has put a lot of work and thought into building the world of Nightingale, so we're excited to share it throughout development with you.[/i]

[b]Q: Anything more about how using magic will work? / what kind of type magic will be in the game, like directional, fire, traps?[/b]

[i]A: As humans lack innate magickal abilities, spells need to be tethered to a weapon or tool crafted in the realms. But be warned, using the spells will use up some of the durability. We'll have additional details about how many spells are in and their natures closer to launch as they're still in development.[/i]

[b]Q: Will Nightingale have mod support for a more customizable player experience? An example being custom building assets or armor skins. / Modding support?[/b]

[i]A: We're still looking into this one. We'll have a definitive answer closer to the early access launch. [/i]

[b]Q: How in-depth with the settlement/village building be? Will it have a size limitation, and about how much of the 2kmX2km area will the limit be if so? Can NPCs build for you via something like a project board, as long as you provide the mats?[/b]

[i]A: Currently players can build wherever they like, landscape and other natural features permitting. We are working hard to ensure performance is maintained even with very complex player-built structures.[/i]

[b]Q: Will there be plans for Mounts/tamed animals/pets? Or other forms of transportation fitting to the theme? / How do you obtain a pet? / Are pets/mounts/tames functional (mount)/cosmetic only or combat assist capable? Will we be able to issue orders? (stay, follow, attack, don't attack, etc) / Will there be a feature to tame creature to our side? / So youve hinted at befreinding gaints depending on how you play what about animals and fantastical beasts could you become something like a beast tamer/trainer? Will you be able to craft gear for them in turn like ive seen air balloons could you hook an animal up to a cart or carriage perhaps? A camping wagon?[/b]

[i]A: Pets and mounts are two different systems in our game. Pets have been prototyped but we haven't moved them into production. Mounts have not been looked at to any significant degree. We'd love to have pets ready during Early Access!
[/i]
Phew! And that's the end of this first round! Thank you all once again for your questions. Head over to [url=https://discord.gg/playnightingale]Discord[/url] and submit your questions for the next Q&A. 

‍

notes.title: Community Spotlight - July 2022

notes.title: All Nightingale Realm Cards, their effects, and how to craft them
notes.content:
What are the Nightingale Realm Cards? If you plan to leave the home comforts of your Respite Realm's estate behind and strike off into the great Faewilds, then Realm Cards are your first port of call. These cards put the power of procedural generation directly in your hands, allowing you to tailor any prospective expedition to your needs. With endless possibilities at your fingertips, we're here to walk you through all the Nightingale Realm Cards at your disposal.

Realm Cards give you control over the setting and theme of Nightingale's procedurally generated worlds, allowing you to impose modifiers to gather unique resources or encounter rare bosses. The crafting game's deck is also set to expand as Inflexion Games continues to add new content during early access. Once you close a portal, the exact specifications of that realm are lost forever. If you want to make the most out of this core mechanic, here's every Nightingale Realm Card and how to craft them.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: New Gameplay Trailer | Introducing Realm Cards

Hey there, future Realmwalkers!

We just revealed a brand new trailer at Summer Game Fest, which you can watch here: https://youtu.be/cb59tYE72ps

We revealed some new gameplay and details which you can read more about here on our blog: https://www.playnightingale.com/post/realm-cards-endless-adventures-across-the-fae-realms

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/9f94a2bd0a4ea00a421c147d0b914e77a10fd413.jpg[/img]

[h2]Realm Cards[/h2]

When the portal networks collapsed, Realmwalkers were stranded across many worlds.

Luckily they have arcane magick to continue their adventures: Realm Cards.

Craft cards from materials you find in the realms and discover how each card greatly affects the world you connect to. 

Our systems designer, Alexei, explains more about them [url=https://www.playnightingale.com/post/realm-cards-endless-adventures-across-the-fae-realms]here[/url].

Even if you didn't notice this adversary, it certainly noticed you.

This being is just one of the myriad of foes the Fae have unleashed on the Realms; threatening the livelihood of any Realmwalker who is unlucky enough to stumble across one.

[h2]… And More![/h2]

Eagle eyed viewers will have noticed new giants, snapshots of basebuilding, and various realm types to explore.

We still have so much more to show you, so make sure to follow our social channels for more information and sign up for our newsletter to get alerted for future playtest opportunities.
